to answer — not a voi

This role covers 7am to 2:30pm Mountain Time, Monday through Friday (Mountain Time)

title: Health Coach for US Eczema Program (Written Support, No Calls)
description:
One day a week to start (6–8 hrs every Monday), growing as we grow



No client calls, no video, no evenings.



Skills:  English writing, health/wellness experience, attention to detail



---



Job description:



I'm a naturopathic doctor in California and I run Cleanbody, a program that helps people with severe eczema find and fix the root causes of their skin problems.



Most of the people who come to us have been struggling for years. They've tried steroids, elimination diets, and a dozen creams. By the time they find us they're exhausted and they've stopped believing anything will work.



Our program works — but only if people stick with it all the diet and lifestyle changes that are a part of our program. 



Every week, our members write in a journal — how they slept, what they ate, whether they took their supplements, how their skin feels. You read those entries and you write back. You tell them what they're doing well. You ask what's getting in the way. You remind them that week six is hard for almost everyone and they're not behind.



You are not giving medical advice. You never comment on symptoms, interpret results, or suggest changes to anyone's protocol. I do that. Your job is encouragement, accountability, and noticing — and I'll train you thoroughly on where that line sits and exactly what to say.



This is a one-day-a-week job, every Monday. Members submit their journals by Sunday night; you read them all on Monday and write back to each one. Then you send me a short report on who's doing well, who's gone quiet, and what questions came up — which I use to plan our members' live call that week.



No calls, no video, no evenings, no being on call. If you're a good, warm writer who genuinely cares whether someone gets better, you'll be good at this.



What you'll do:



Every Monday:

 • Read every member's journal and weekly update form (about 10 minutes each)

 • Write a short, warm, specific reply to each one

 • Note anyone who's gone quiet and reach out to them

 • Send me a report: anything I need to know, who's stalling, the three questions that came up most, and one win worth sharing on the call



Throughout:

 • Learn the Cleanbody Method thoroughly, so your encouragement is specific rather than generic

 • Never answer a clinical question. Urgent things reach me automatically through our system — your job is to notice patterns, not emergencies.



What you need:

Required

 • Excellent written English — warm, natural, not stiff or formal

 • Genuine interest in health, nutrition, or wellness

 • Careful and consistent: every member gets a reply every Monday, without fail

 • Comfortable following a script and knowing when to escalate rather than improvise

 • Reliable internet and a quiet place to work on Mondays

 • Able to commit long-term. This role grows as we grow.



Nice to have:

 • Background in nursing, nutrition, psychology, or health coaching

 • Personal or family experience with eczema, allergies, or chronic skin conditions

 • Experience with any patient portal or CRM



Not required:

 • Any medical qualification

 • Any experience with US healthcare

 • Phone or video work — there is none

 • Availability outside Mondays



What it's like to work here:



We're small. Right now it's me, a virtual assistant, and soon you. I'm honest about what I need, I don't micromanage, and I'd much rather you ask a question than guess.



I'm expecting a baby in March 2027 and will be on leave from March to June. During that time you'll be the main human presence our members have — which is exactly why I want to hire and train someone properly now, rather than scrambling later.



If you do this well, this role grows. More hours, more members, and more responsibility.



How to apply:



Please don't send a generic application — I read every one and I can tell.



Send me:

 1. A short note about why this role interests you. Not your CV — just tell me why encouraging people through something difficult appeals to you.



 2. This writing sample. Here is a member's journal entry from their sixth week:



"Honestly this week was rough. My skin flared up worse than it's been in a month and I don't know why. I've been doing everything — I haven't had dairy in five weeks, I'm taking all the supplements, I'm sleeping better than I was. And it still got worse. I'm starting to wonder if this is worth it. I skipped my journal a few days because I didn't want to write it down."



Write your reply. Around 100–150 words. Remember: you're not a doctor and you can't tell them why their skin flared or what to change. You can notice what they've done, acknowledge how it feels, and help them keep going.



 3. The word "CLEAN" in the subject of your message, so I know you read this properly.

I read everything myself. Applications without the writing sample won't be considered.

Salesforce

Field mapping

CRM data structure

Essential:

title: Floor Plan Quality Reviewer (Remote, Full Time)
description:
About the role

Roomio customers scan a property with their phone and receive a finished floor plan drawn by our design team. You will be the final check on every floor plan before it goes to the customer. You compare each plan against the order, the scan and the customer’s template, then approve it, fix small issues yourself, or send it back to the design team with a clear reason.

This is a detail focused, checklist driven role at a steady pace. You need to spot a wrong label, a missing element or a measurement that does not add up, quickly and consistently, all shift long.



What you will do

- Review every floor plan before release: template followed, property title and address correct, room labels correct, metric or imperial as the customer requested, site plan included when required, measurements consistent, floor count and orientation match the scan, legend and file format correct.

- Approve plans that pass. Fix small issues yourself in Adobe Illustrator or Photoshop (labels, address, title, legend, units). - Send plans with layout, measurement or template faults back to the design team with a reason code.

- Prioritise the queue so that express orders and orders close to their deadline are checked first.

- Open the 3D scan when something looks wrong and confirm whether the fault is in the drawing or the scan.

- Log every defect you find by category so we can see what is recurring.

- Join a short weekly review with the Product Manager on recurring issues and suggest fixes.

- Flag repeat problems that our automated checks should catch in future.



What you will not do

- Customer support or customer contact. Our customer service team handles that.

- Chasing late orders. That is handled elsewhere.



Requirements

- Experience drafting or checking real estate floor plans. You can read a floor plan the way a drafter does.

- Competent in Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop, editing vector floor plan files quickly and accurately.

- Comfortable working through a high volume of plans against a fixed checklist without losing accuracy.

- Able to read a 3D scan or virtual tour well enough to check layout and measurements against the plan.

- Clear written English. Your reject notes must be short and specific.

- Reliable internet and a quiet workspace for the full shift, every shift.

- Available Tuesday to Saturday, 6:00am to 2:00pm Melbourne time.



Nice to have

- Experience in a QA, inspection or production role with deadlines.

- Familiarity with LiDAR scanning apps

- Comfortable using admin web portals and dashboards.

- Experience giving structured feedback to a design or drafting team.



Tools you will use

Roomio order portal, supplier portal, scan viewer, Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop, Slack, Notion.



Reporting

You report to the Product Manager and receive technical training from our CTO.



How to apply

Send your CV plus two examples of real estate floor plans you have drafted or checked. In your application, name three things you would check first on a floor plan before it goes to a customer.

title: Medical Biller & Certified Coder (CCS)

WordPress

title: Field Service Scheduling & Operations Virtual Assistant
description:
Note: Interested applicants must submit their initial application exclusively through the OnlineJobs platform. Do not
 the company directly. Any candidate who contacts the company outside of the OnlineJobs system will be disqualified from consideration.



Field Service Scheduling & Operations Virtual Assistant



$6–$8 USD/hour | Full-Time | Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM U.S. Central Time



Every day, dozens of cleaning appointments depend on someone noticing small scheduling problems before they become big ones.



We are looking for that person.



Maid In America Cleaning Services is hiring a highly organized Field Service Scheduling & Operations Virtual Assistant to coordinate mobile cleaning teams, maintain accurate operational data, and communicate with customers when schedules change.



This is not a general administrative assistant role. This role is best suited for someone with experience coordinating schedules, customers, and day-to-day operations in a fast-paced service environment.



What You’ll Do



Your primary responsibility will be helping keep our field operations organized and running on schedule.



You will:

-Prepare and adjust cleaning schedules in Jobber

-Coordinate changes caused by call-outs, delays, and customer rescheduling requests

-Identify overlaps, drive-time issues, staffing conflicts, and other schedule problems

-Reassign or resequence jobs within established guidelines

-Answer inbound customer calls related to scheduling and basic support

-Make outbound calls to communicate delays and schedule changes

-Maintain accurate customer, job, and service information

-Update operational trackers and reports

-Complete invoicing, payroll-support, and cost-of-service tasks

-Escalate decisions that require management approval



You will follow established processes while also using judgment when a situation does not perfectly match the written procedure.



Who We’re Looking For



You may be a strong fit if you:

-Notice small details and inconsistencies others miss

-Work quickly without sacrificing accuracy

-Enjoy solving scheduling and logistics problems

-Follow SOPs, checklists, and operating rules consistently

-Can investigate and solve routine problems independently

-Know when to stop and escalate a decision

-Communicate confidently and professionally with customers

-Stay calm when priorities change

-Learn new software quickly

-Take ownership of mistakes and correct them promptly



Experience



Previous experience in scheduling, dispatching, operations coordination, or managing appointments in a fast-paced service environment is preferred.



Direct experience scheduling or dispatching employees who travel to customer locations is strongly preferred, but candidates with strong general scheduling, customer service, administrative coordination, or operations experience may also be considered.



Relevant backgrounds may include:

-Residential cleaning

-HVAC

-Plumbing

-Electrical

-Landscaping

-Pest control

-Home health

-Delivery

-Property maintenance

-Appointment scheduling

-Customer service

-Administrative or operations coordination

-Managing changing schedules, CRM updates, multiple priorities, and operational processes



Strongly Preferred

-Direct Jobber experience

-Experience with other field-service platforms

-Customer phone support experience

-Dispatch or logistics experience

-Google Workspace

-Slack

-Spreadsheet and reporting experience



Work Requirements

-Full-time availability

-Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM U.S. Central Time

-Fluent spoken and written English

-Reliable computer and dedicated workspace

-Reliable internet connection with a backup option

-Backup power solution

-No work for another employer or client during scheduled working hours



Compensation



$6–$8 USD per hour, based on directly relevant experience.



Candidates with direct Jobber experience, mobile-team scheduling experience, and strong customer phone skills will receive priority consideration.



Our Core Values

-Communication

-Connection

-Quality

-Service

-Teamwork



How to Apply



Complete our Culture Index survey:


/p/8Y0GG4Nyz4

Please make your answers specific and based on your actual experience.



Applications that do not complete the Culture Index survey or do not provide enough information for us to understand your relevant experience may not be reviewed.

title: Content Feedback Manager: $1,000–$1,200 USD START RATE
description:
Salary: Start at $800 a month + performance-based bonuses (TOTAL: $1,000–$1,200 a month once trained)

Senior CFMs earn $1,500+ after 6–12 months.



Payment: Twice a month via Wise. Always on time.



ABOUT US



Young Publisher – 



We are an international digital marketing company working with content creators and online brands. The company has over 85 employees around the world. We've been in the industry since 2019. We're currently serving over 1,000+ high-ticket clients per year.



We provide an 80% done-for-you content and monetization system that helps creators grow, go viral, and turn views into income using short-form content, AI tools, and proven strategies. Our clients are typically beginners or early-stage creators looking to build their brand, gain followers, and generate income online.



We focus on structure, accountability, and long-term growth.

We focus strongly on client delivery and producing client results.



BENEFITS



- Full-time position: 7.5 hours daily, Monday-Friday; 37.5 hours a week

- Flexible schedule: Choose your own hours, as long as you show up for the daily meeting (MANDATORY)

- Stable income: Long-term role with regular, on-time payments

- Supportive team: Collaborative environment without micromanagement

- Growth path: Opportunities to increase responsibilities and earnings

- 100% remote: Work-from-home setup



TASKS



Content & Client Feedback



- Review 50-100 short-form client videos (Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts) per day in our Slack feedback channel -before they are published

- Give constructive, actionable feedback on hooks (verbal/headline/visual), scripting, pacing, editing, and CTA, making sure each client knows exactly how to improve

- Cross-reference each piece of content with client niche, experience, and goals as outlined in their files

- Review previous feedback to ensure consistency and avoid contradictions

- Quality-control content ideas created by our Content Research Experts before delivery to the client, ensuring fit with niche, experience, and likely performance

- Oversee workload balance among Content Research Experts and make sure no one on the team is overloaded or underutilized

- Respond to client questions or tech issues in Slack within 24 hours

- Be tough but fair—only approve content that meets quality standards



Progress Tracking



- Complete daily End-of-Day (EOD) reports

- Attend daily team meeting (mandatory, 3pm CET)

- Keep internal feedback and client progress records up to date



REQUIREMENTS (MUST-HAVE)



- C1+ English (written), with perfect grammar and clear, professional responses

- Significant experience creating or reviewing short-form content for Instagram Reels, TikTok, or YouTube Shorts

- Organized and detail-oriented

- Reliable internet and a quiet, professional home workspace

- Accountability mindset and deadline commitment

- Long-term commitment, eager to master a workflow and have direct impact on client success



BONUS SKILLS (NOT REQUIRED)



- Experience supporting creators and social media beginners, especially ages 45+

- Familiarity with AI tools like ChatGPT, CapCut, etc.

- Strong understanding of trends/strategy for Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts



WHY JOIN US?



- Monthly Performance Bonuses: Rewarding high-quality feedback, consistent task completion, and strong teamwork.

- Fully Covered Software: Access to all necessary premium tools and software provided.

- Great Work-Life Balance: Sustainable hours with no graveyard shifts.

- Professional Growth: Accelerate your skill set through regular feedback and advanced training.



HOW TO APPLY



Fill in the form to apply: 
/to/O40RINeW



Important note: Put "CFM" + [Your Name & Family Name] in the "Name" field in the form.



P.S. Once hired for this position, you will be hired and contracted under Social Influence Consulting LLC

title: Full-Time WFH Account Manager — $2,000 Base + Bonuses
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



Full-Time | Monday-Friday | PH Morning / US Evening Coverage



We are hiring Philippines-based Client Success Managers to support U.S. clients during evening hours, especially Pacific Time.



This is a client leadership role, not just support.



You will own the client relationship, keep clients clear and accountable, create momentum, prevent frustration, and escalate risks early.



This role is best for someone with excellent English, strong emotional intelligence, high ownership, and confidence handling high-ticket clients calmly.



Success is measured by retention, trust, communication, accountability, client momentum, and risk prevention.



SALARY



- Ramp / Trial CSM: USD 1,500/month base

- Certified CSM: USD 2,000/month base

- OTE: USD 2,500-3,000+/month with performance bonuses

- Paid twice a month via Wise

- Certification is performance-based, usually reviewed after 30-60 days, and requires consistent performance, quality-control review, and leadership approval



SCHEDULE



- Monday-Friday

- Full-time: 7.5 hours a day; 37.5 hours/week

- Core client coverage: 6 AM-12 PM PH time

- Split shifts are allowed

- Afternoons and early evenings are generally free

- Required team/training meetings may happen around 9 PM-11 PM PH time

- Occasional client calls may run up to 12 PM PH time when needed

- Final schedule will be agreed during hiring and must be sustainable long-term



ABOUT US



We help creators, beginners, coaches, and business owners grow and monetize online using short-form content, AI tools, strategy, coaching, and accountability.



We provide an “80% done-for-you” content and monetization system that helps clients turn short-form content into audience growth, leads, and income.



We have worked with 4,000+ clients since 2019.



Most clients are U.S.-based, and many are age 45+, so patience, clarity, emotional intelligence, and professional English communication are very important.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run client kickoff calls using our onboarding framework

- Set clear expectations from day one

- Help clients understand what to do next and why it matters

- Keep clients accountable to action items and deadlines

- Follow up with stuck, quiet, inactive, or delayed clients

- Re-engage clients before momentum is lost

- Respond to client messages within 24 weekday hours

- Close loops and avoid dangling threads

- Handle difficult conversations calmly and professionally

- De-escalate frustrated or emotional clients

- Identify refund, payment, chargeback, cancellation, and satisfaction risks early

- Escalate issues quickly according to SOPs

- Keep clear notes in Airtable / CRM

- Coordinate internally when support or escalation is needed

- Support renewals, referrals, testimonials, and upsell opportunities when appropriate

- Join required trainings, daily team Zoom calls, and feedback sessions

- Once activated, host a weekly client-support call or own a similar client-success responsibility



CLIENT LOAD



You will ramp gradually.



The target for a Certified CSM is 40-50 active clients, depending on client complexity, program type, and client inflow.



When fewer clients are available, CSMs may support reactivation, offboarding, client check-ins, and legacy-client cleanup.



BENEFITS



- Fully remote role

- Payment: Twice a month via Wise, always on time

- Performance-based bonuses

- Clear path from Ramp / Trial CSM to Certified CSM

- Growth opportunity into leadership

- Supportive international team

- Daily trainings and team Zoom calls

- SOPs, support, and structure provided

- Work with creators, brands, short-form content, and AI tools

- Required tools paid for after the test month where applicable

- Afternoons and early evenings generally free, with required evening meetings



REQUIREMENTS



- Currently based in the Philippines

- Fluent, professional English

- Clear and easily understood verbal communication

- Strong communication and emotional intelligence

- Calm under pressure

- High ownership, follow-through, and reliability

- Strong say-do ratio and respect for deadlines

- Comfortable handling difficult, emotional, or high-ticket clients

- Comfortable with uncomfortable conversations

- Strong Airtable / CRM documentation habits

- Reliable internet connection and professional home setup

- Willing to use Hubstaff during working hours

- Able to work PH morning / U.S. evening hours

- Comfortable with split shifts and required evening meetings

- Able to manage up to 40-50 active clients once trained and certified

- Able to meet certification standards without heavy supervision

- Able to identify and escalate refund, payment, chargeback, cancellation, and client-satisfaction risks quickly



NICE TO HAVE EXPERIENCE



- Client Success

- Account Management

- Coaching

- High-ticket programs

- Online education

- Social media monetization

- Content strategy

- Creator economy

- AI tools like ChatGPT, CapCut, or Submagic

- Working with U.S. clients



WE’RE THE RIGHT FIT IF



You’ll likely thrive here if you:



- Enjoy client-facing communication

- Stay calm when clients are emotional, frustrated, or confused

- Take ownership without needing to be micromanaged

- Follow through consistently and stay organized

- Want a long-term role with growth potential

- Can balance empathy with accountability

- Are comfortable working with U.S.-based clients



HOW TO APPLY



Apply here:



IMPORTANT: Put “CSM” + Your Full Name in the Name field.



P.S. Once hired, you will be contracted under Social Influence Consulting LLC.

title: Sales Operations Coordinator / Sales Admin
description:
Remote | Part-Time | PhilippinesFirst Response Sales is looking for a highly organised Sales Operations Coordinator to support the day-to-day running of sales teams across high-ticket, property advisory and professional service businesses.



This is not a GoHighLevel developer role.



We already have technical support for CRM builds and automations.



Your responsibility will be making sure the sales team actually follows the processes, the CRM stays accurate, the numbers are correct, and nothing gets missed.



What You'll Be Responsible For

Checking the CRM daily and maintaining strong CRM hygiene

Making sure setters and closers are updating opportunities correctly

Checking notes, outcomes, next actions and follow-up dates are completed

Identifying stale opportunities and following up with the responsible sales rep

Making sure every lead has an owner and clear next action

Checking that booked calls, no-shows, shows, qualified opportunities and closed deals are recorded correctly

Monitoring setters and closers for missing or inaccurate data

Preparing daily, weekly and monthly sales reports

Maintaining setter and closer KPI scorecards

Tracking:

Leads received

Contact attempts

Contact rate

Appointments booked

Show rate

Qualification rate

Close rate

Revenue

Lead-source performance

Updating Google Sheets and internal reporting documents

Helping prepare information for sales management meetings

Following up with setters and closers when tasks or CRM updates have not been completed

Organising sales documents, SOPs and internal files

Helping onboard new setters and closers into the systems

Checking calendars and appointment information

Supporting general sales administration

Flagging problems to management before they become bigger issues

What We're Looking For



You need to be extremely organised and comfortable holding salespeople accountable.



You should be the type of person who notices when:



A lead hasn't been contacted.



A closer hasn't updated an opportunity.



A setter hasn't added notes.



A follow-up date is missing.



The CRM numbers don't match.



A deal has been sitting in the same stage for too long.



A KPI suddenly drops.



And instead of waiting to be asked, you investigate it and bring it to management.



Experience We're Looking For



Experience in some combination of:



Sales Operations

Sales Administration

CRM Administration

Appointment Setting Operations

Sales Support

Executive or Operations Assistance within a sales business

KPI reporting

Google Sheets / Excel

Pipeline management

High-ticket sales environments



Experience with GoHighLevel is helpful, but you do not need to be a GHL automation specialist.



Experience supporting setters, SDRs, BDRs or closers is highly desirable.



Hours



Initially approximately 10–15 hours per week.



There is significant opportunity for the role to grow as First Response Sales takes on more clients.



What Success Looks Like



I should be able to open the CRM or your weekly report and immediately understand:



What the sales team has done

Where every opportunity sits

Which reps are performing

Which reps aren't following process

Where leads are being lost

What needs my attention



The goal is to make the sales operation organised, measurable and accountable.



To Apply



Please send:



A short introduction

Your previous experience supporting sales teams

Any experience you have with CRM management and sales reporting

An example of a KPI report or sales tracker you've managed, if available

Your hourly rate in USD

Your available hours per week



Please start your application with the words “SALES OPS” so I know you've read the full post.

title: Full-Stack Developer
description:
Remote Full-Stack Developer: Build a Custom CRM for a London Property Management Company



The project



We're looking for an experienced full-stack developer to design and build a custom CRM system from scratch. You'll work remotely and directly with our London team to understand our processes, then turn them into a fast, reliable, easy-to-use platform our staff will use every day.



The system will cover:



Rent roll: a clear view of every property, tenant, rent amount, due date, and payment status, with arrears flagged automatically

Maintenance: logging repair and maintenance requests, assigning contractors, and tracking each job through to completion

Task tracker: creating, assigning, and following up on tasks across the team, with due dates and reminders

Compliance tracking: storing gas safety certificates, EICRs, EPCs, deposit protection, Right to Rent checks, and licences, with alerts before anything expires

Landlord statements: automatically generating monthly statements showing rent collected, fees, and maintenance costs

Communication log: recording every
, call note, and message against the right tenant, landlord, or property

Document storage: keeping tenancy agreements, inventories, certificates, and ID documents in one place, linked to each property and tenant

Automated reminders: sending rent due reminders and arrears chasers to tenants by
 or text

Tenant and landlord portals: tenants can report repairs and view payments, and landlords can view statements and documents

Contractor management: a directory of contractors with trades and rates, plus tracking of quotes, invoices, and spend per property

Inspections: scheduling property inspections and completing them on a mobile phone, with photos saved to the property record

Accounting integration: connecting with Xero or QuickBooks

Bank integration: connecting to our bank account so rent payments are matched to tenants automatically

Lettings pipeline: tracking empty properties, applicants, viewings, and referencing

Management dashboard: arrears, empty properties, open maintenance jobs, and upcoming expiries at a glance



For reference, we like the way platforms such as Arthur Online and The Wyze work. Please take a look at both to get a feel for the kind of functionality we want. We're not looking for a copy of either, but a system built specifically around how our business runs.



What we need from you



We are looking for someone who is truly excellent at what they do. You must have:



Proven experience building CRM systems. Please show us examples of CRMs you have built, with live links, screenshots, or a portfolio.

Strong back-end skills, such as Node.js, Python/Django, PHP/Laravel, 
, plus solid database design using PostgreSQL, MySQL, or similar

Strong front-end skills, such as React, Vue, or Angular, with an eye for clean, simple interfaces

Experience building and connecting APIs and third-party integrations

A good understanding of data security and privacy, as our data is covered by UK GDPR

Experience deploying and maintaining apps in the cloud, such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud

The ability to manage the project from planning through to launch

Good written and spoken English, reliable internet, and clear, regular communication



Nice to have: experience with property management or real estate software, and experience with Open Banking, bank feeds, or accounting software integrations.



We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Direct Response Video Editor (Meta / TikTok Ads)
description:
Job Overview

We are a fast-growing DTC e-commerce brand looking for a sharp, conversion-focused Direct Response Video Editor for Meta 
 & Instagram) and TikTok Ads.



This is not a traditional cinema editing role. We are not looking for cinematic showreels, corporate brand hype videos, or music videos. We need a visual marketer who understands direct response consumer psychology, retention graph optimization, and how to stop the scroll in the first 3 seconds.



You will collaborate directly with our Creative Strategist, taking raw UGC, product footage, AI footage, and conceptual hooks, and turning them into high-intent, high-converting video creatives that drive clicks and purchases. You understand how visual pacing, sound design, on-screen kinetic captions, and split-screen patterns keep mobile users glued to the screen.



Core Responsibilities

⚬ End-to-End Direct Response Editing: Edit high-converting video ad formats including UGC mashups, problem/solution native ads, 3-reasons-why, founder-led explainers, and TikTok-style native demos using editing tools like Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve.

⚬ Collaboration with Creative Strategist: Turn creative briefs, storyboards, and hook concepts into dynamic, performance-driven video assets without needing constant micro-management.

⚬ Rapid Hook & Angle Iteration: Systematically produce 3–5 alternative 3-second visual hooks for winning ad bodies to combat creative fatigue and unlock new scale.

⚬ Retention Pacing & Motion Design: Implement native captions, jump cuts, visual b-roll overlays, kinetic text, sound effects (SFX), and UI mockups that feel organic to the feed while driving urgency.

⚬ Performance Analysis: Review weekly creative metrics (3-second hook rate, hold rate/retention curves, and outbound CTR) with the team to understand why an ad won or lost, using the data to improve the next batch.



Required Qualifications & Skills

⚬ Direct Response Video Experience: Demonstrated track record editing high-converting video ads specifically for Meta and TikTok. You understand the difference between "aesthetic editing" and "selling on camera."

⚬ Software Mastery: High proficiency in video editing tools like Adobe Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve.

⚬ Direct Response Creative Portfolio: You have a portfolio/showcase containing active or past DTC e-commerce video ads (applications without an ad portfolio will not be reviewed).

⚬ Native Platform Literacy: You live and breathe short-form content. You know current audio trends, visual memes, capcut-style text pacing, and what makes an ad feel native rather than corporate.

⚬ Excellent English & Copy Nuance: Strong grasp of American/Western e-commerce phrasing, pacing, and on-screen hook formatting.

⚬ Reliable Workstation: Stable high-speed internet (plus a reliable backup connection) and a powerful editing rig capable of rendering and managing 4K/raw footage without bottlenecks.



Nice-to-Haves

⚬ Familiarity with creative research and swipe-file tools (Foreplay.co, TrendTrack, Meta Ad Library).

⚬ Experience with sleep-tech, consumer health, or premium home goods DTC brands.

⚬ Light motion graphics experience (creating custom UI overlays, comparison tables, or press badge popups).



How to Apply

Please include:

 1. A direct link to your video portfolio or Google Drive folder containing e-commerce direct response video ads you personally edited (do not send cinematic reels or corporate video work).

 2. The video editing software and computer specs you use.

₱95,000/month, paid semi-monthly via Payoneer.

40 hours/week, 9:00 PM to 6:00 AM Manila time. Remote, Philippines based.



We are a US startup with a live iOS and web platform that connects American

homeowners with licensed contractors - plumbers, electricians, HVAC, roofers,

remodelers. The product is built and working. What we do not have yet is

contractors on it. That is this role.



WHAT YOU WILL ACTUALLY DO



Call and text US contractors from lists we build for you. Walk them through

signup and get them to submit their first quote - they will need hand-holding

at every step, and that is the job. Follow up with the ones who go quiet.



Roughly: 60% contractor outreach, 25% getting homeowners to post jobs,

15% d
 what goes out on our channels.



WHAT MAKES THIS DIFFERENT



You are not the bottleneck here. We are an engineering team, and we build

whatever you need - scrapers to build your contact lists, CRM setup, automated

follow-ups, landing pages, ad creative, AI calling and chat tools. You describe

what you want, we build it and hand it back to you working.



That means your time goes into conversations and closing, not manual busywork.

Most sales people never get this.



WE ARE LOOKING FOR



- 3+ years in outbound sales. B2B or BPO outbound both count.

- Real experience calling US businesses. You are comfortable on the phone with

  a 55-year-old roofing contractor who has been burned by lead-gen companies.

- Natural spoken and written English. It does not need to be perfect.

- Organized enough to run a few hundred contacts without dropping follow-ups.



Experience with home services, construction, or field service software

(ServiceTitan, Jobber, Housecall Pro) is a bonus, not a requirement.



THE HONEST PARTS



This starts as a 5-month contract and continues from there. We have budgeted

for this to keep going - we would much rather grow one person than rotate

through five.



The night shift is real and it will not change. We would want this to be your

main commitment.



HOW TO APPLY



Click Apply on this page and send your CV, plus two things:



1. The closest thing you have done to this, with real numbers. Contacts made,

   close rate, accounts activated - whatever you actually owned.



2. The cold text message you would send to a plumber in Tampa, Florida to get

   him onto our platform. Under 300 characters.



That is it. If it looks like a fit, we will ask for a short voice intro at the

next step.

title: E-Commerce Technical & Digital Performance Specialist
description:
Full-Time Remote | Long-Term Opportunity | Australian E-Commerce Brand



We are an Australian fashion/e-commerce business looking for an experienced E-Commerce Technical & Digital Performance Specialist to join us full-time remotely.



This is NOT a social media manager role.



We are not looking for someone to simply create Instagram posts, write captions or maintain a content calendar.



We are looking for someone who understands the technical backend of an e-commerce business and can take ownership of our digital ecosystem — Shopify, Google, Meta, tracking, analytics, SEO, advertising infrastructure and performance.



Initially, this will be a hands-on audit, repair and optimisation project. Once the foundations are working correctly, the role will evolve into ongoing digital growth and campaign management.



THE INITIAL PROJECT



Your first responsibility will be to thoroughly review our existing digital setup.



We want you to find what is working, what isn't working, what has been configured incorrectly, what is missing and what can be improved.



This includes reviewing and working directly with:



Shopify — store configuration, apps, integrations, technical issues, site structure and performance



Google Analytics 4 (GA4) — tracking, events, conversions, attribution and reporting



Google Tag Manager



Google Search Console



Google Merchant Center and product feeds



Google Ads — account structure, conversion tracking, audiences and campaign infrastructure



Meta Business Suite / Business Manager



Meta Ads Manager



Meta Pixel and Conversion API



 and Instagram account integration



Shopify/Meta/Instagram catalogue and commerce integrations



Domain verification and associated Meta assets



SEO — technical SEO, on-page SEO, indexing, metadata, site structure, schema and organic search opportunities



Website speed and technical performance



Conversion tracking and attribution



E-commerce analytics and reporting



We don't just want reports telling us there is a problem.  We want someone capable of actually fixing the problems.



THEN WE WANT TO GROW



Once the digital foundations are correct, your role will progressively move into performance and growth.



You should be comfortable looking at real business data and understanding what it means.



That includes metrics such as:



Traffic | Conversion Rate | ROAS | CAC | CPA | CTR | CPC | AOV | Revenue | Customer Acquisition | Returning Customers | Funnel Performance | Organic Traffic | Search Rankings



More importantly, you need to understand what levers to pull when those numbers aren't where they should be.



We want someone who can investigate why performance is changing and then take action.



That could mean improving SEO, restructuring a campaign, correcting tracking, improving a landing page, changing audiences, fixing a product feed, improving site structure or identifying another problem within the customer journey.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



You should have genuine hands-on experience with several of the following:



Shopify / GA4 / Google Tag Manager / Search Console / Merchant Center / Google Ads / Meta Business Manager / Meta Ads Manager / Meta Pixel / Conversion API / Instagram integration / Technical SEO / E-commerce Analytics / CRO



You don't necessarily need to be the world's leading expert in every platform.



But you do need to understand how these systems connect and work together.



We are looking for someone who:



Is technically strong and enjoys solving problems



Can work independently and take ownership



Understands e-commerce and digital performance



Is highly analytical



Can interpret data rather than simply produce reports



Can identify problems and recommend solutions



Is comfortable implementing fixes personally



Can clearly explain what they have found and why it matters



Documents changes and maintains an organised digital environment



Is interested in building something over time rather than completing isolated freelance tasks



WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT



This is not primarily:



Social media management, Graphic design, Influencer management, Posting content to Instagram, Writing captions, General virtual assistant work



Those functions may interact with your role, but they are not why we are hiring you.



We are hiring you to understand, manage and improve the technical and performance infrastructure behind our e-commerce business.



THE OPPORTUNITY



We are initially looking at approximately a 6-month full-time engagement, with the potential for this to become a permanent long-term position.



The first stage will focus heavily on auditing, repairing and improving our existing infrastructure.



From there, we want the successful person to become increasingly involved in SEO, Google Ads, Meta advertising, website optimisation, analytics, conversion optimisation and overall e-commerce growth.



You will work directly with the business owners and will have significant ownership over the project.



We care much more about capability, initiative and results than qualifications.



HOW TO APPLY



Please do not send us a generic application.



Start your application by telling us about yourself and your experience. 



Then answer the following:



1. Tell us about a Shopify store where you personally worked on the technical/performance setup. What did you actually do?



2. What would you check first if Shopify showed 100 orders but GA4 only reported 65 purchases?



3. What are the first things you would audit inside Meta Business Manager for an established e-commerce brand?



4. Explain the difference between Meta Pixel tracking and Conversion API in simple terms.



5. What would you investigate if organic Google traffic had been declining for six months?



6. What are the five most important e-commerce metrics you would want to see every week, and why?



7. Which of these platforms would you consider yourself genuinely advanced in?



Shopify / GA4 / GTM / Search Console / Merchant Center / Google Ads / Meta Business Manager / Meta Ads / Technical SEO / CRO



8. What is your expected monthly salary for a full-time position?



9. What country and city are you based in?



10. Please provide examples of e-commerce businesses you have previously worked with and explain your personal involvement.



We are looking for someone who wants to take ownership of the digital engine of the business, understand the numbers, fix the problems and help us grow it.

title: Shopify Product Categorization & Shipping Data Specialist
description:
We are a German e-commerce company specializing in premium furniture, lighting, home decor and lifestyle products.



We are looking for a highly detail-oriented and structured person to join our existing product team and support us with product categorization, shipping-related product data and catalog data quality in Shopify.



You will work closely with our team lead, Kristine.



Your Main Responsibilities

1. Product Categorization in Shopify



You will systematically review our existing Shopify catalog and make sure that products are categorized correctly and consistently.



Your tasks will include:



assigning and maintaining Product Types

assigning Shopify Product Categories

creating and maintaining Product Tags

cleaning up inconsistent or outdated tags

identifying incorrectly categorized products

applying our internal categorization rules to new and existing products

helping us create a clean and consistent product structure across the entire catalog



The goal is to build a structured product database that can later be used for filtering, search, automation, shipping logic and product feeds.



2. Shipping-Related Product Data



A major part of your role will be researching and maintaining shipping-related product information.



Depending on the product, this may include:



shipping source

shipping type

number of packages

package dimensions

package weight

delivery-time category

other relevant shipping data



For the shipping source, we only use three possible options:



Esszett Luxury Berlin location

Manufacturer warehouse

Droppery



Individual manufacturers are not created as separate warehouse locations.



The manufacturer/vendor is maintained separately in Shopify.



Important Rules for Shipping Data



You are not expected to guess shipping information.



We will provide clear rules for how products should be classified.



If package dimensions, package weights or other information are missing, you may need to research them using:



manufacturer websites

supplier portals

product data sheets

existing Shopify data

supplier information



If information cannot be found reliably, it should not be guessed. Instead, it should be marked so that we can request the missing information from the manufacturer.



It is especially important to understand the difference between:



product dimensions and package dimensions.



For shipping purposes, we need the actual dimensions of the shipping package.



If a product is shipped in multiple packages, we ideally need the dimensions and weights of each individual package.



Your Role in the Team



We already have an existing product team with clearly defined responsibilities.



Our team lead Kristine is responsible for team coordination, quality control, variants, related product structures and uploading creatives.



Arvie is responsible for general product editing and product data.



Davinci is responsible for graphic creatives.



Your role will mainly focus on:



Product Categorization + Shipping Data + Data Quality



You are not replacing an existing team member. You are joining the team to take ownership of an additional specialist area.



What We Are Looking For



You should be:



highly detail-oriented

very organized

comfortable working with large product catalogs

confident using Shopify

comfortable working with structured data

able to follow clear rules consistently

able to identify missing or inconsistent information

willing to research product and shipping data carefully

reliable when working through repetitive tasks without losing accuracy

Experience We Prefer



Experience with the following is highly preferred:



Shopify

Product Types

Shopify Product Categories

Product Tags

Metafields

Google Sheets or Excel

CSV files

large product catalogs

product data research



You do not need to be a programmer.



We are looking for someone who understands structured product data and can work accurately and systematically.



Important



Please do not apply if your Shopify experience is mainly limited to copying product descriptions or uploading images.



We are specifically looking for someone who enjoys working with product structure, categorization and data quality.



German language skills are not required.



Basic German knowledge is a plus, but our internal communication can be in English.



How to Apply



Please answer the following questions in your application:



How many years of Shopify experience do you have?

Have you worked with Product Types, Shopify Categories and Product Tags before?

Have you worked with catalogs containing more than 1,000 products or SKUs?

Do you have experience with Metafields?

How comfortable are you with Google Sheets or Excel?

Have you researched package dimensions, weights or other logistics data before?

Which Shopify apps or tools have you used?

How many hours per week are you available?

What is your expected hourly rate in USD?



Please start your application with the words:



PRODUCT STRUCTURE



This helps us identify applicants who have read the full job description.

Training is paid at a flat rate of $125 USD and runs from September 28 - October 2, 2026, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM PHT, including a one-hour lunch break. Full attendance, active participation, and completion of all learning assessments are required.

title: Accountant
description:
We are an Australian financial advisory company seeking a highly capable Offshore Accountant to support our accounting operations. We are looking for someone with solid Australian company experience, strong attention to detail, and advanced hands-on experience using Xero platform. 



This role is ideal for an accountant who is confident working independently, understand Australian business and tax processes, and can deliver accurate, timely, and insightful financial support.

- Comfortable working with an Australian team and Australian business standards. 

- Able to take ownership of finance tasks with minimal supervision. 

- Process-driven, accurate, and committed to meeting deadlines.

title: AI Video Editor (Pet Supplement)
description:
Can you create an ad that makes someone stop scrolling in the first 2 seconds — and gives them a reason to buy?



If your answer is yes, keep reading.



We’re not looking for another video editor.



We’re looking for someone who can take an idea, turn it into a complete ad using AI, and create content that actually drives sales.



Because a polished video means nothing if nobody watches it.



Great ads start with great hooks, strong messaging, and a clear understanding of what makes people stop, pay attention, and take action.



If you understand that, you might be exactly who we’re looking for.



## What You’ll Do



You’ll create high-converting ads from start to finish using AI.



Your work will include:



* Creating AI avatars

* Producing AI voiceovers

* Creating UGC-style content from scratch

* Editing raw footage when needed

* Developing new hooks, angles, and creative concepts

* Turning ideas into ads designed to generate sales



You won’t just be editing footage.



You’ll be responsible for turning an idea into creative that gets attention and drives action.



## You’re a Great Fit If...



* You don’t just edit — you create

* You’ve already built ads using AI tools

* You understand what makes people stop scrolling

* You know how to create strong hooks and compelling messaging

* You think about conversions, not just aesthetics

* You think like a marketer, not just an editor

* You bring ideas instead of waiting to be told what to do



## AI Experience Is Required



You should already be comfortable using tools like:



* ElevenLabs

* Kie ai

* Higgsfield

* Veo

* Nano Banana



If these tools are completely new to you, this probably isn’t the right role.



We’re looking for someone who can jump in and start creating.



## Bonus Points If...



* You’ve scaled winning ads using AI

* You understand what’s working on Meta

* You know how to spot creative trends early

* You understand direct-response advertising

* You’re constantly coming up with new creative ideas

* You know how to turn one winning concept into multiple variations



## What You’ll Get



* Consistent work

* Performance-based upside

* Access to real campaign data

* Fast, honest feedback

* The opportunity to see which creatives actually drive results

* A team that values creativity, initiative, and performance



## This Isn’t a Typical Video Editing Role



If you’re looking for someone to hand you footage, give you a script, and tell you exactly what to do, this isn’t the role for you.



But if you can look at an ad and immediately think:



“Here’s how I’d make this hook stronger.”



“Here’s why people are dropping off.”



“Here’s a better angle we should test.”



Then we want to hear from you.



If you know how to combine AI, creativity, and marketing to create ads that capture attention and convert, apply below.

Australian construction or landscaping experience is highly regarded. We use Simpro, Groundplan, Microsoft Teams, Excel and Microsoft Planner, and experience using AI and automation to improve project management and efficiency will also be highly regarded.



This is a long-term career opportunity, not a short-term freelance position. RYCOR Landscapes already employs several valued team members in the Philippines, and we want the successful person to become an important part of our team with the opportunity to grow their responsibilities and progress their career as the company grows. We offer flexible working arrangements, a supportive team environment, exposure to high-quality Australian construction projects and the opportunity to help develop better systems, technology and AI processes within the business. We value people who take ownership, think ahead, communicate confidently and continually look for better ways of doing things. If you are ambitious, commercially minded and want a role where you can have a genuine impact on project performance rather than simply completing administrative tasks, we would love to hear from you.

AI Product Content Creator (Higgsfield)



WHAT WE DO



We make short videos and photos of products — clothes, shoes, bags, home goods. We don't shoot them. We generate them with AI.



This is an example of what we create.





THE JOB



We send you a screenshot of a shot we like, plus photos of the product. You:



- Write the prompt

- Make image versions in Higgsfield

- Pick the best one

- Turn it into a short video

- Send us the finished clips



VOLUME



10 finished videos per day. That means 10 we approve, not 10 tries. Expect to redo shots that come out wrong.



PAY



$300 per month. We pay for the Higgsfield subscription. You just do the work.



YOU NEED



- Good English, spoken and written. Prompts are long and detailed. Sloppy wording gives bad output.

- Experience with Higgsfield or a similar AI image/video tool

- A good eye — you can look at a photo and see why it works

- Patience. Most shots take a few tries.

- Care about detail. If the product doesn't match our photos exactly, we can't use it.

- Steady output, and a heads up if a day will fall short



NICE TO HAVE



- You know what does well on TikTok and Instagram

- Basic photo or video editing









OUR STYLE RULES



We have a set of rules every shot has to follow — how to keep the product accurate, how to frame it, how the motion should work. We'll go over them with you once you're hired.



TO APPLY



Answer these two questions:



1. What tools have you used?

2. What other AI videos have you made? Send examples.



THE TEST



We will provide:



- A reference video — one we made. This shows the style we want: the camera angle, the lighting, how the person moves, how the product is shown.

Your job: make a video of that product in the same style as our reference.



That means:

• Ongoing wedding-video editing in small, clearly defined assignments

• Weekly payment through PayPal for approved work

• An average of US$500 per month

• A clear path from a short skills assessment to paid training and then regular paid work with our team



WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU



• Working knowledge of Adobe Premiere Pro

• A Windows PC suitable for running Adobe Premiere Pro — this workflow is PC-based

• Ability to receive payments through PayPal

• Careful attention to instructions and detail

• Fast, dependable delivery and responsive communication

• Conversational English

• Availability Monday–Friday, 09:00–14:00 GMT+3, during training. After training, you can work anytime you like as long as you meet deadlines.

• Willingness to ask questions and report progress



Previous wedding or multicamera editing experience is welcome, but it is not required. Some of our best editors joined us without any wedding-editing experience.



STEP 1: SHORT SKILLS ASSESSMENT



Shortlisted candidates complete a brief paid editing assessment before training, for which you will be paid. The assessment uses real wedding footage from a project that was completed and delivered several years ago. You will not send us the Adobe Premiere Pro project file. You will submit only timeline screenshots and low-quality video renders so we can review the timing of your cuts, the beats, and which shots you selected—nothing more. The assessment consists of an already synced five-minute multicam timeline and a 30-second reception timeline and should take approximately 10 minutes of editing time if you have some experience editing in Adobe Premiere Pro. It is used to confirm that you can understand the workflow, follow instructions accurately, communicate well, and deliver on time.



STEP 2: PAID TRAINING



Candidates who pass the test enter paid training. You receive access to our learning platform, training videos, tutorials, and guidance from a personal tutor during the training hours above. Training continues until you reach the editing standard required for ongoing work. The training rate and milestones will be confirmed before training begins.



ONGOING PAID WORK AND CONTINUED TRAINING



Once you complete the initial training, you will begin receiving a constant flow of paid wedding-video assignments with synced material and clear instructions. Our syncers handle synchronization, our ML system supplies the preprocessed multicam, you vet the result, and our QC team reviews the complete multicam.



The learning does not stop when the paid work begins. Your real assignments will go hand in hand with continued training as you learn every part of our wedding-video workflow. You will progress step by step through the different types of edits until you reach the highest level: creating complete wedding highlights.



We are looking for editors who want to stay, improve, take on more responsibility, and become long-term members of our team.



HOW TO APPLY



1. Start your application with the word CEREMONY so we know you read the full post.

3. Confirm that you work on a Windows PC.

4. Confirm that you can receive payments through PayPal.

5. Confirm that you can be available Monday–Friday, 09:00–14:00 GMT+3, during paid training.

6. If you have edited wedding videos before, you are welcome to include one link to your best wedding highlight. This is optional; previous wedding-editing experience is not required.

title: AI Influencer Content Creator & Social Media Growth Specialist
description:
# AI Influencer Content Creator & Social Media Growth Specialist



**Remote | Part-Time | 1–2 Hours Per Day**

**Pay: $250–$350 for the initial 30-day period, depending on experience**

**AI Tool Budget: Up to $50 additional**

**Performance Bonuses: $500 + $600 opportunities**

**Long-Term Position Available**



We are a growing company in the **health, fitness, wellness, supplements, and skincare space**, and we are looking for a serious, creative, hardworking person to build and manage **4 AI influencer social media accounts**.



This is not a position for someone looking to put in minimal effort or simply generate random AI pictures.



Our goal is to create **extremely realistic AI influencers that look and feel like real people**, build genuine social media audiences around them, and eventually introduce our brands and products naturally through their content.



## THE 4 AI INFLUENCERS



You will be responsible for creating and developing four completely different personalities:



**1. Black Beauty / Lifestyle Influencer**

A beautiful Black female influencer with striking blue eyes. Her content can focus on beauty, skincare, lifestyle, fitness, fashion, and wellness.



**2. Female Influencer With Vitiligo**

A beautiful woman with vitiligo who has a distinctive, memorable appearance. Her content can combine beauty, skincare, lifestyle, wellness, fitness, fashion, and relatable everyday content.



**3. Health & Wellness Expert**

A highly knowledgeable health-focused personality centered around nutrition, herbs, supplements, food, fitness, healthy living, and wellness education.



This person should feel intelligent, credible, and genuinely knowledgeable—not like an AI account simply repeating generic health information.



**4. Korean Beauty / Lifestyle Influencer**

A beautiful Korean female influencer focused on skincare, Korean beauty, glass skin, beauty routines, lifestyle, wellness, fashion, and related content.



Each influencer must have their **own personality, visual identity, content style, interests, and reason for people to follow them.**



## YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES



You will:



* Create all **4 AI influencer accounts**

* Develop a consistent face, appearance, personality, and content direction for each influencer

* Post **2 times per day on each account**

* Create approximately **8 quality posts per day across the 4 accounts**

* Create both **AI videos and image-based content**

* Research viral content and trends in each influencer's niche

* Study successful TikTok, Instagram, and AI influencer accounts

* Write hooks, captions, concepts, and content ideas

* Continuously improve AI image and video quality

* Make the influencers look as realistic and consistent as possible

* Build each account toward its first **1,000 followers**

* Track which posts perform best and create more content based on what works

* Eventually begin naturally integrating our skincare, health, wellness, fitness, and supplement products into successful accounts



## CONTENT QUALITY IS EXTREMELY IMPORTANT



Posting just to say you posted is **not acceptable**.



For example, an image post should not simply be one boring AI-generated picture with no concept behind it.



Each post needs to have a reason someone would:



**STOP → WATCH → READ → COMMENT → SHARE → FOLLOW**



You can choose between video posts and image/carousel-style posts, but the content needs to be interesting and well thought out.



We care much more about **quality, creativity, realism, and growth** than simply checking off the requirement of posting twice a day.



## AI REALISM



One of the most important parts of this position is creating influencers that **do not immediately look AI-generated**.



We want:



* Highly realistic skin

* Natural body proportions

* Consistent faces

* Natural expressions

* Realistic environments

* Realistic lighting

* Realistic food and objects

* Natural movement in videos

* Normal smartphone/social-media-style footage

* Consistent personalities

* Content that feels like it came from a real creator



We do NOT want obvious AI images, plastic-looking skin, changing faces, strange hands, unrealistic movements, or generic AI content.



## YOU MUST BE WILLING TO LEARN



You do NOT need to know everything on Day 1.



However, you must be someone who learns extremely quickly and constantly improves.



Before beginning, you will be expected to watch approximately **7–8 detailed YouTube videos about creating AI influencers**, including AI image generation, consistent characters, AI video generation, social media growth, and realistic AI content creation.



After that, learning should continue every day.



AI changes extremely quickly.



We want someone who is constantly discovering:



* Better AI tools

* Better prompts

* Better video models

* Better image generators

* Better methods for keeping faces consistent

* Better viral hooks

* Better editing techniques

* Better social media strategies



Your work should look noticeably better after 30 days than it did during your first week.



## 30-DAY TRIAL → LONG-TERM POSITION



The first **30 days will be an evaluation period**.



We are not expecting every account to become huge in 30 days.



What we ARE looking for is effort.



We will be watching:



* Did you post consistently?

* Did you improve?

* Did you research?

* Did you test different content?

* Did you learn new AI skills?

* Did the quality improve?

* Did you study what competitors are doing?

* Did you try different hooks and formats?

* Did you take responsibility for growing the accounts?

* Did you treat the accounts like they were your own business?



The people who demonstrate exceptional effort and consistency will be considered for a **permanent long-term position with us.**



We are building multiple brands and AI influencer networks, so there is significant room to grow with the company.



## COMPENSATION



**Initial 30-Day Pay:**

$250–$350 depending on your experience and quality of previous work.



**AI Tools:**

We are willing to provide up to an additional **$50 toward approved AI tools** needed to produce better content.



### PERFORMANCE BONUSES



**Reach 1,000 Followers → $500 Bonus**



Successfully grow an account to **1,000 followers** and earn a **$500 performance bonus**, subject to authentic growth and company review.



**200,000+ View Post → $600 Bonus**



Create a post that reaches **200,000+ legitimate views** and earn a **$600 performance bonus**, subject to company review.



We want to reward people who can actually create content that performs.



## WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



You are a good fit if you are:



* Hardworking

* Extremely reliable

* Creative

* Consistent

* Fast learner

* Interested in AI

* Interested in social media

* Interested in health, fitness, wellness, beauty, or skincare

* Comfortable researching trends

* Able to work independently

* Obsessed with improving the quality of your work

* Able to accept feedback and make changes quickly

* Looking for a serious long-term opportunity



Experience with tools such as ChatGPT, Higgsfield, Midjourney, Kling, Veo, Runway, CapCut, Photoshop, image generators, AI video generators, or similar platforms is a major advantage.



## IMPORTANT



We are looking for **serious long-term people only**.



Please do not apply if you plan to generate a few basic AI pictures every day and consider the job finished.



We want someone who thinks:



**“How can I make this account better today than it was yesterday?”**



If something isn't working, test something else.



If your AI videos don't look realistic, learn how to improve them.



If an account isn't growing, study successful accounts and figure out why.



If a competitor is getting millions of views, analyze what they're doing differently.



We value **initiative and results.**



## HOW TO APPLY



Please send:



1. Your previous AI image or AI video work

2. Any social media accounts you have previously managed or grown

3. AI tools you currently know how to use

4. Examples of realistic AI people you have created

5. Your experience with TikTok, Instagram, Reels, or Shorts

6. A short explanation of why you believe you would be good at this job



If you have never created an AI influencer before but believe you can learn quickly, you may still apply—but show us other work that demonstrates your creativity and ability to learn.



**DO NOT send a generic copy-and-paste application.**



We are looking for people who actually read this job description and understand what we are trying to build.



**Serious applicants only. We are looking for people who want to grow with us long term.**

title: Growth Specialist, US Home Services Marketplace (Night Shift, US Hours)
description:
Type: Full time contract, 5 months, with extension based on results Rate: ₱95,000/mo, paid via Payoneer, semi-monthly Hours: 40/week, US business hours (approx. 9:00 PM to 6:00 AM Manila time) Location: Remote, Philippines based



What we are building

We are an early stage US startup building a marketplace that connects American homeowners with licensed local contractors. Electricians, plumbers, HVAC, roofers, remodelers, and the rest of the trades.



The difference between us and the incumbents matters, so here it is plainly. Companies like Angi and Thumbtack sell the same lead to five contractors and take payment up front, which is why contractors resent them. We do not sell leads. Homeowners post a job, get free quotes, and pay one milestone at a time into escrow, releasing each stage only after they approve the completed work. Contractors join free, quote only the jobs they want, and get paid through Stripe when a stage is approved.



Our iOS app and web platform are live. Identity verification, state license checks, insurance certificates, milestone escrow, disputes, and in-app messaging are all built and working.



What we do not have yet is a market. That is this role.



The job

You are our first non-technical hire and you own launch. Your job is to fill one US metro with active contractors, get homeowners posting jobs, and turn that into completed, paid work.



Roughly how your week will split:



Contractor outreach and activation (about 60% of your time) Build target lists from state license boards, Google Maps, and local trade groups. Cold call and text contractors. Walk them through signup, Stripe onboarding, and insurance upload, because they will drop off at every step if nobody holds their hand. Follow up with the ones who go quiet. Get them to submit their first quote.



Homeowner demand (about 25%) Local
 groups, Nextdoor, Reddit, and community pages in our launch ZIP codes. Small paid tests. Getting real homeowners to post real jobs.



Channels (about 15%) Own our social channels and scheduling. This is not a content creation role. You d
 what goes out, when, and to whom, and our team produces it. You are not making graphics in Canva all day.



You plan it, we build it

We are an engineering team. Everything technical is handled on our side, so the only thing you need to bring is the idea and the plan.



Graphics, video, ad creative, landing pages,
 and SMS sequences, scrapers to build your contractor lists, dashboards, CRM setup, automated follow-ups, AI voice and chat tooling. If you can describe what you want and why it will move one of our four numbers, we will build it and hand it back to you working.



That means you are never blocked waiting on a designer, and you never lose a week to manual busywork. Tell us what you need and it gets automated. Your time goes into strategy, conversations with contractors, and closing.



We are looking for someone who takes this seriously as an unfair advantage. The right person will show up with far more ideas than a normal marketer could ever execute, because normally you would be the bottleneck. Here you are not.



How we will measure you

Not followers. Not posts published. These four numbers:



Verified contractors onboarded in the launch metro



Percentage who have submitted at least one quote



Median time from a job being posted to its first quote



Jobs completed and paid



Who we are looking for

5+ years in outbound sales, partnerships, or growth. B2B or BPO outbound both count.



Real experience calling US-based businesses. You are comfortable on the phone with a 55 year old roofing contractor who has been burned by lead-gen companies before.



Clear, natural written and spoken English. Not perfect, but natural.



Organized enough to run a pipeline of hundreds of contacts without dropping follow-ups.



Self-directed. You will be working while our founder sleeps for part of your shift.



Genuinely fine with the night schedule. Please do not apply hoping it will change.



Nice to have: experience with home services, construction, field service software (ServiceTitan, Housecall Pro, Jobber), or a marketplace or two-sided platform.



This is not a fit if

You are currently juggling several clients. We are asking for this to be your one commitment. Night shift is hard on the body and nobody does it well while servicing three other accounts in the daytime. Ten hours in a day is realistically the ceiling for anyone, and we would rather you sleep than stack contracts. If you already have a full roster, please leave this one for someone who can give it their full attention.



You want a content creation or graphic design role



You want warm inbound leads handed to you



You have only done social media management



You need a fully documented playbook on day one. We will give you direction and targets, but you will be figuring out a lot of it with us.



Why this is worth your time

You get a full engineering and AI team executing your ideas, which is not something most marketers ever get. You will be the person who launched a market. If you hit the targets in five months, this becomes a longer engagement with expanded scope, and you will have a story almost nobody in the local job market can tell.



How to apply

Send the following. Applications missing any part will not be reviewed.



Your CV or a link to your profile.



A short note on the closest thing you have done to this, with actual numbers. Contacts made, close rate, accounts activated, whatever you owned.



Write the cold text message you would send to a plumber in Tampa, Florida to get him onto our platform. Under 300 characters. This is the main thing we are evaluating.



A 60 second voice recording (any format) introducing yourself, as if we were the plumber picking up your call.



One thing you would want our team to build or automate for you in your first month, and what it would do for the numbers above. Two or three sentences is enough.



Tell us what else you are working on right now and how many hours a week it takes. We are not looking to catch anyone out, we just want to know this will be your main commitment.



Confirm you can work US business hours and that you have or can set up a Payoneer account.

title: Video Editor - AI video creation
description:
Females under 35 preferred.



We’re looking for a hungry, ambitious Video Editor to join our e-commerce creative team long-term.



Experience is preferred, but it is NOT the most important thing we are looking for.



We are open to early-career editors who may not have years of professional experience yet.



If you are honest, reliable, highly coachable, good at following instructions, comfortable learning new tools, and genuinely want to become an excellent editor, we strongly encourage you to apply.



We can teach skills.



What is much harder to teach is attitude, attention to detail, work ethic and honesty.



The Role



You will create short-form video advertisements for e-commerce brands using:



Reference advertisements

Creative briefs

Existing footage

AI-generated visuals

Voiceovers

Product assets

UGC-style content

Animation and B-roll



A big part of our creative process involves studying advertisements that already work and adapting them while preserving the important elements of the original reference.



You should be comfortable following a proven structure rather than unnecessarily reinventing it.



What You’ll Do

Turn creative briefs and reference ads into finished e-commerce video ads

Study references carefully and recreate their hook, pacing, structure and visual rhythm

Edit UGC-style, animated and AI-assisted advertisements

Create AI images, talking-head scenes, product footage, animations and B-roll when required

Learn and use tools such as ChatGPT, Google Flow / Veo, Kling, ElevenLabs, HeyGen and CapCut

Maintain realistic characters, products, hands, movement and continuity

Understand what the advertisement is trying to communicate, not just mechanically edit footage

Check your own work carefully before submitting it

Catch subtitle, audio, product, formatting and export mistakes yourself

Organize your projects, source files and final exports properly

Learn our internal editing systems and workflows



You are not expected to already be an expert in every tool we use.



We will provide training and clear workflows.



However, when we teach you a process, we expect you to follow it.



The Type of Person We Want



We’re looking for someone who is:



Hungry to improve

Honest

Reliable

Highly coachable

Detail-oriented

Comfortable receiving feedback

Able to follow detailed instructions

Willing to learn completely new software and AI tools

Interested in social media, content and advertising

Able to adapt quickly as tools and workflows change

Comfortable working inside an established system

Serious about becoming an excellent video editor



Early-career editors who are ambitious and want an opportunity to learn rapidly and develop their skills are strongly encouraged to apply.



Honesty Is Extremely Important



This deserves its own section.



If you make a mistake, tell us.



If you didn't follow an instruction correctly, tell us.



If you don't know how to do something, tell us.



If you've never used a particular tool before, tell us.



You will never be punished for honestly admitting that you don't know something or that you made a mistake.



What we will not tolerate is lying, hiding mistakes, pretending you followed a process when you didn't, or exaggerating your abilities.



We would rather train an honest beginner than manage an experienced editor we cannot trust.



Our Standard



We care about four things:



1. Correct message

Understand what the advertisement is actually trying to communicate.



2. Believable execution

description:
We are a small U.S.-based business helping property owners who are behind on their property taxes.
