### Pay



* $3–$5 USD per hour

* Temporary, part-time position

* Pay may increase later if call volume, hours, or responsibilities increase

* This is not currently a full-time role



### Schedule



* Temporary position: approximately 8–12 weeks

* 10–15 hours per week

* Usually 2–4 hour calling blocks

* Calls will be made during appropriate U.S. Central Time hours

* Available to start as early as next week

* First 15 days will be a paid probationary period



### What You Will Do



* Make outbound cold calls from a list we provide

* Follow a simple calling script

* Confirm that you are speaking with the property owner

* Ask a few basic questions

* Collect and update contact information

* Record call results and notes

* Identify owners who would like to speak with us

* Make follow-up calls when requested



This is NOT a high-volume dialing position. You will be working the same list of approximately 200–300 property owners over several weeks, with multiple attempts when necessary.



### Important



You will NOT negotiate property deals, provide tax or legal advice, or pressure property owners.



Your job is to communicate professionally, gather information, and refer interested owners back to us.



Approximately 30–40% of the people called may be senior citizens, so patience, respect, and clear communication are very important.

* Clear and easy-to-understand spoken English

* Comfortable speaking with U.S. property owners by phone

* Friendly, patient, and professional

* Able to follow a script without sounding robotic

* Good note-taking skills

* Reliable internet and quiet calling environment

* Dependable and able to work scheduled hours

* Willing to accept coaching and feedback



No previous real estate, property tax, or cold-calling experience is required. We are willing to train the right person.



### Future Opportunity



This role starts at $3–$5 per hour because it is a temporary, limited-volume project. If the business expands into additional counties and the role grows in hours, call volume, or responsibility, compensation can increase as well.



When applying, please include:



1. A short introduction about yourself

2. Your availability during U.S. Central Time

title: Amazon Brand Manager
description:
Apply -> 



ABOUT FLAPEN

Flapen is an Amazon growth company. We launch and scale brands end to end — product research, positioning, creative, listings, and ads — for sellers who want to compete with operators far larger than they are. Every launch starts with our own research platform: proprietary market data that d
 which niches are worth entering before a dollar goes into inventory.

Most Amazon brands lose on the shelf before anyone reads a word of their listing. Our work is to make sure that doesn't happen: sharper positioning, main images that earn the click, listings that convert the traffic they get.

- 300+ Amazon product launches run end to end

- Founded by an operator with 8+ years building and scaling Amazon brands

 

ROLE

We're hiring an Amazon Brand Manager to run brands for our clients. Not advise on them, not consult on them — run them. You own P&L, strategy and execution end to end for the brands you're assigned, from a first launch with zero reviews to a mature catalog defending its position. This is for someone who has already carried a brand's numbers on Amazon, not someone who wants to learn on ours. Your performance is measured on real numbers: TACOS, conversion rate, return rate, margin, and revenue growth. Not activity. Results.

 

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Own listings, strategy and marketplace performance for the brands you're assigned.

- Monitor and optimize KPIs including TACOS, profit margin, conversion rate, and sales velocity

- Coordinate across Creative, PPC, Sourcing, and Ops to hit brand targets

- Lead new product launches from idea to live listing: timeline, deliverables and go-live date.

- Flag risks and growth opportunities early — a stock-out, a margin leak, an unused traffic channel — with a recommendation attached.

- Lead client communication via Slack and Zoom

- Manage tasks in ClickUp and ensure nothing falls behind



REQUIREMENTS

- You have managed full-funnel Amazon brand performance at an agency, brand-side, or aggregator

- You have worked across product launches, PPC strategy, and margin improvement

- You understand Amazon metrics: TACOS, ACoS, CVR, forecasting, and the 5 traffic channels (organic, advertisement, promotion, influencer, off-channel)

- You communicate clearly and take initiative. No hand-holding required.

- You are comfortable with async, remote teamwork and can manage your own schedule

- You are reliable, organized, and perform in high-ownership roles

- You are fluent in English and client-facing ready



Bonus Points

- Experience managing private-label brands across multiple categories

- Exposure to creative or sourcing processes

 

LOCATION & HOURS

- Remote.

- Async by default. 40-hour week across five 8-hour days.

- We track hours. That log is how your pay is calculated.

- Your rate, your scope and your promotion are d
 on outcomes — what you shipped, what it moved in TACOS and margin, and what that movement was worth in revenue to the brand.

 

WHAT WE OFFER

- Competitive pay, performance bonuses, and career growth opportunities.

- Fully remote, permanently. No return-to-office plans, because there is no office to return to.

- Ownership of your projects with zero micromanagement. You are briefed on the outcome, not the steps.

- A fixed annual paid time off allowance.

- Budget for tools, courses and AI subscriptions you can make a case for.



HOW TO APPLY



Apply through the link below. You'll be asked to record a short introduction video — it takes about five minutes and it's the fastest way for us to see how you think. Applications sent as messages on the job board are not reviewed.

Key Responsibilities

Plan, build and manage paid advertising campaigns across Meta Ads and Google Ads.

Manage campaigns focused on lead generation, bookings, sales, website traffic, awareness and event promotion.

Build suitable campaign, ad-set and audience structures.

Set up prospecting, retargeting and remarketing campaigns.

Complete audience, keyword and competitor research.

Work with the creative team to identify effective messaging, formats and advertising assets.

Write and test clear, persuasive ad copy.

Optimise campaigns based on reliable performance data.

Produce clear reports that explain performance, insights and recommended next steps.

Manage multiple advertising accounts within a fast-moving agency environment.

Essential Requirements

Minimum of two years’ professional paid advertising experience.

Intermediate to advanced knowledge of Meta Ads Manager.

Strong working knowledge of Google Ads.

Experience managing campaigns across multiple client accounts.

Understanding of campaign objectives, audience targeting, bidding, budgets and attribution.

Experience with lead-generation, conversion, booking and ecommerce campaigns.

You understand the relationship between creative quality, audience targeting, campaign structure and the customer journey. You are confident making decisions based on data while recognising when a campaign needs stronger creative, a better offer or an improved landing page.

title: Transportation Operations & Customer Service Coordinator
description:
Prio Auto Transportation is looking for a reliable and professional Transportation Operations & Customer Service Coordinator to support our vehicle transportation operations remotely.



The successful candidate will communicate with customers by phone, text message, and
 while assisting with quotes, bookings, delivery updates, dispatch-related tasks, and general customer service.



Responsibilities:



* Answer incoming customer calls professionally

* Provide vehicle transportation quotes and information

* Transfer calls to the appropriate team member when necessary

* Respond to customer text messages and
s

* Take new transportation orders and collect all required information

* Provide customers with estimated pickup and delivery times

* Follow up on quotes and potential orders

* Bid on available vehicle transportation loads

* Enter, update, and manage loads in Super Dispatch and other company systems

* Prepare and process invoices when required

* Contact customers regarding outstanding payments when instructed by management

* Maintain accurate records of customer conversations, orders, payments, and load information

* Communicate with customers, drivers, dispatchers, and managers

* Complete other transportation operations and administrative duties as assigned



Qualifications:



* Excellent spoken and written English

* Strong customer service and telephone communication skills

* Ability to write clear and professional
s

* Strong attention to detail and organizational skills

* Comfortable speaking with customers and handling different personalities

* Able to multitask and work in a fast-paced environment

* Reliable, punctual, and able to work independently

* Ability to follow instructions and company procedures

* Reliable high-speed internet connection

* Own computer and a quiet, professional working environment

* Previous experience in customer service, dispatching, logistics, transportation, freight brokerage, or administrative support is preferred

* Experience using Super Dispatch or similar transportation software is an asset, but training may be provided



Working Hours:



The required schedule is Monday to Friday, from 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Canadian Eastern Time.



Because the employee will be working remotely from the Philippines, this will be an overnight position. The corresponding hours in the Philippines are:



* 8:00 p.m. to 5:00 a.m. Philippine Time while Canada is observing daylight-saving time

* 9:00 p.m. to 6:00 a.m. Philippine Time while Canada is observing standard time



Canada changes its clocks twice each year, so the Philippine schedule will shift by one hour depending on the time of year. The employee must follow Canadian Eastern Time and be available throughout Prio Auto Transportation’s full business day.



The first weekly shift will begin Monday evening in the Philippines. The final weekly shift will begin Friday evening and finish Saturday morning.



Please apply only if you are comfortable working these overnight hours on a permanent basis.



We are looking for someone dependable, professional, organized, and interested in developing a long-term position with our company.

title: Email Marketing & Conversion Specialist
Client Operations Supervisor - Remote
description:
About Flowstate

We are a performance-first, AI-first,
 and lifecycle automation agency working with mid-tier and enterprise brands across many industries. What sets us apart is how we deliver: we combine data-driven strategy with AI-powered execution. That means AI agents,
 workflow automation, smart data integration, and practical automation that actually drives growth - not hype.



We help our clients understand where automation and AI truly move the needle and how to implement it in a sustainable, compounding way. We also eat our own cooking - using automation internally to accelerate delivery, streamline operations, and raise the quality bar.



Our team is remote-first, fast-moving, and we take pride in delivering exceptional work without the agency fluff.



The Role

We're looking for a Client Operations Supervisor to be the operational backbone of our client delivery, working alongside the General Manager. You'll sit at the centre of the agency - connecting our GM/Head of Operations and delivery team to ensure every client engagement runs smoothly, on time, and on process.



This is not a traditional account management role focused on relationship hand-holding. This is an operational role focused on systems, processes, and execution. You'll own how client work gets done, keep the team on track, and make sure nothing falls through the cracks.



A key difference here: automation and AI are central to what we do. You don't need to be a strategist or a builder - we'll train you on our approach. But we do need someone who is genuinely interested in how sales, marketing, and business automation work, can talk about it credibly with clients, and can support the rollout alongside our builders and client leads.



What You'll Do

- Own the execution of the operational client delivery processes: onboarding, project execution, reporting, and offboarding

- Coordinate project timelines and deliverables across multiple client accounts

- Maintain client health dashboards, delivery tracking, and operational reporting

- Serve as the primary operational contact for clients on day-to-day execution matters, with GM/HOO as escalation path

- Build literacy in sales, marketing, and business automation - we'll train you on our approach and offerings

- Support the rollout of automation and AI initiatives alongside our builders and client leads

- Prepare meeting agendas, notes, and action items for client and internal meetings

- Track project budgets and flag issues before they become problems

- Manage operational tools (Asana, GHL, Slack, Google Workspace)

- Identify process improvements and work with the GM/Head of Operations to implement them

- Provide weekly operational summaries to leadership



What We're Looking For

- 3+ years experience in an operations, project coordination, or client services role - agency experience strongly preferred

- Strong organisational skills and attention to detail

- Comfortable with project management tools (Asana experience is a big plus)

- Experience with CRM platforms (GHL/HighLevel experience highly regarded)

- Genuine interest in automation, AI, and how businesses can use them - even if you're early in learning

- Excellent written and verbal communication in English

- Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

- Self-starter who takes ownership and doesn't wait to be told what to do

- Familiarity with
 marketing, automation, or digital marketing is a bonus



Why Join Us

- Fully remote - work from anywhere in the Philippines

- Direct exposure to agency leadership, strategy, and real-world automation delivery

- Work with premium brands across Australia and internationally

- We'll invest in training you on automation and AI so you build genuine expertise on the job

- Opportunity to grow into a senior operations role as the agency scales

- Supportive team culture with clear expectations and regular feedback  



To be considered for this role, please follow the application instructions below. INCOMPLETE applications will not be reviewed.



 Subject: Client Operations Supervisor



Please include the following in the cover letter.

- Resume

- Send a  loom video (3 minutes) Introducing yourself and speak specifically to your experience with Client Services, Project Management, GoHighLevel, and AI tools.

title: META MEDIA BUYER ($1,500–$2,000 ) – HIGH-TICKET LEAD GENERATION (FULL TIME)
description:
META MEDIA BUYER — HIGH-TICKET LEAD GENERATION (FULL TIME)

Salary: $1,500–$2,000 USD/month (based on experience + performance bonuses)

Location: Remote

Hours: Minimum 4 hours overlap with US business hours (PST or EST)

Tracking: Time Doctor is required



------------------------------------------------------------



ABOUT US



We are a fast-growing performance marketing and lead generation agency working with premium, high-ticket service brands across the United States.



Our mission is simple: generate high-quality leads and booked appointments that convert into closed deals and long-term revenue for our clients.



We are looking for a highly skilled
 / Meta media buyer who knows how to turn paid traffic into qualified, high-ticket leads and scale campaigns profitably. If you can consistently produce leads that close, we want to speak with you.



We run campaigns across a range of high-ticket verticals (home services, solar, finance, coaching, professional services and similar). Experience in any high-ticket lead generation niche is welcome — solar is a nice-to-have, not a requirement.



------------------------------------------------------------



YOUR ROLE



You will manage and scale Meta advertising campaigns across multiple high-ticket client accounts.



This is not an entry-level media buying role.



We are looking for someone who understands:

• High-ticket lead generation

• Buyer psychology and intent

• Conversion-focused creative testing

• Appointment and lead quality

• Funnel optimisation

• Scaling systems

• KPI accountability



------------------------------------------------------------



CAMPAIGNS YOU'LL MANAGE



Lead Generation & Appointment Funnels

• High-ticket lead generation funnels

• Consultation & quote-request funnels

• Appointment-booking campaigns

• Application / qualification funnels

• Local and multi-location campaigns



Full Campaign Ownership

You will manage the complete campaign lifecycle: strategy, campaign setup, creative testing, optimisation, scaling, reporting, and performance analysis.



Platforms & Systems

•
 Ads Manager & Business Manager

• GoHighLevel, HubSpot, Calendly, Zapier

• Landing page funnels & CRM automation systems



------------------------------------------------------------



CREATIVE RESPONSIBILITIES



We believe creative is one of the biggest performance levers in paid advertising. You will help develop and optimise:

• Static ads

• Video ads

• UGC-style creatives

• AI-enhanced creatives

• Hook testing frameworks

• Angle testing systems



Tools we use: Canva Pro, CapCut, Premiere Pro, HeyGen, Sora, ElevenLabs, Nano Banana Pro.



------------------------------------------------------------



WHAT YOU SHOULD MASTER



The core of this role is generating high-ticket leads that close. You should deeply understand:

• Direct-response strategy and offer positioning

• High-intent audience targeting and testing

• Lead quality vs. lead volume trade-offs

• Multi-step qualification funnels

• Retargeting systems

• Creative fatigue management

• Pixel tracking, CAPI integrations and lead attribution



------------------------------------------------------------



PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS



We care about results — not vanity metrics. You should be comfortable being accountable to:

• CPL (Cost Per Lead)

• CPA (Cost Per Appointment)

• Appointment / set rates and show rates

• Lead quality and qualification

• Funnel conversion rates

• ROAS and overall acquisition efficiency



Additional KPIs

• Maintain strong CTR performance

• Improve landing page conversion rates

• Reduce lead costs while maintaining quality

• Improve appointment-to-close quality

• Deliver consistent optimisation insights weekly



------------------------------------------------------------



EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS



Required

• 2+ years of
 / Meta Ads experience

• Proven success with high-ticket lead generation

• Experience scaling campaigns while maintaining profitability

• Strong understanding of direct-response marketing

• Ability to analyse performance data and optimise campaigns decisively



Nice to Have

• Experience in any high-ticket service vertical (home services, finance, coaching, professional services, etc.)

• Solar lead generation experience (a small plus, not required)

• Local and multi-location lead generation



------------------------------------------------------------



WHAT TO INCLUDE IN YOUR APPLICATION



Your application will not be considered if you do not follow the format below.



Subject line: "Meta Buyer - [Years Experience] - [Highest Monthly Spend] - [Best Cost Per Lead/Appointment]"



Please include:

• Your latest CV / resume

• Screenshots of campaign performance

• CPL / CPA results achieved

• Ad spend managed

• Campaign scaling examples

• Your best turnaround or optimisation story

• Niches you've worked in

• Markets you've run campaigns for



We fully respect NDAs and client confidentiality. However, applicants must still be able to demonstrate real campaign performance, strategic thinking, and measurable results through metrics or campaign breakdowns. We are not looking for confidential client information — we are looking for proven ability to deliver.



------------------------------------------------------------



PERFORMANCE BONUSES



In addition to base salary, performance bonuses are tied to:

• Qualified leads and appointments generated

• Lead quality and show rates

• Campaign performance

• Client retention and account growth

• KPI consistency



Top performers are rewarded aggressively.



------------------------------------------------------------



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



We want someone who:

• Thinks like a performance marketer

• Understands high-ticket buyer psychology

• Takes ownership of results

• Moves quickly and decisively

• Communicates proactively

• Thrives in fast-paced environments

• Is obsessed with optimisation and improvement



------------------------------------------------------------



RED FLAGS (PLEASE DO NOT APPLY IF)



• You cannot provide campaign metrics or proof of performance

• You rely on generic creatives and copy

title: SOCIAL MEDIA DM APPOINTMENT SETTER
description:
Grow & Glow Fitness | Part-Time | Remote



- ABOUT GROW&GLOW FITNESS:



Grow & Glow Fitness is an Australian online fitness coaching business helping women build stronger bodies, confidence and sustainable lifestyles through personalised training, nutrition and ongoing support.



We're growing and looking for an experienced **Social Media DM Appointment Setter** to join the team and take ownership of lead generation, nurturing and appointment setting.



This is a sales role, but we're not looking for robotic or pushy conversations. Our brand is built around genuine relationships, trust and personal connection, so we want someone who knows how to sell while still communicating like a real person.



- THE ROLE:



Your primary responsibility will be to build relationships with potential clients through Instagram DMs, nurture leads and move suitable prospects towards booking a consultation.



You'll be responsible for:



* Manage and nurture inbound, warm, hot, cold and previous leads through Instagram DMs.

* Proactively reach out to new followers and potential prospects, using genuine engagement such as Story replies, likes and relevant interactions to start conversations.

* Build genuine relationships and rapport, understand prospects’ general goals and struggles, and identify when someone may be suitable for Grow & Glow coaching.

* Follow up consistently with old leads, unanswered conversations and prospects who aren't ready to book yet, ensuring opportunities aren't lost.

* Use engagement from Grow & Glow's soft, medium and hard-selling Stories, polls and CTAs to identify and follow up potential leads.

* Naturally progress suitable prospects towards a consultation, send the Calendly booking link and follow up until they book, where appropriate.

* Handle common questions and objections within the scope of the role while maintaining Grow & Glow's communication style and brand voice.

* Track leads, conversations, follow-ups, bookings and outcomes accurately through Google Sheets, while reporting agreed KPIs.

* Communicate regularly with the coach about lead quality, common objections, opportunities and conversations requiring support.

* As you become familiar with the brand, proactively suggest and assist with approved Story lead-generation content to create additional sales opportunities.



Over time, there may also be opportunities to contribute ideas and assist with approved Instagram Story lead-generation content.



The setter owns the process from **lead → conversation → nurture → qualify → booked consultation**. The coach then takes over the consultation and closing process.



- REQUIRMENTS:



**Previous DM appointment-setting/social media sales experience is REQUIRED.**



You must have:



* Proven previous DM appointment-setting/social media sales experience

* Experience booking appointments through social media conversations

* Experience within a service, coaching or relationship-based sales environment

* Evidence of previous performance and KPI achievement

* Strong understanding of lead generation and the sales process

* Strong rapport-building skills

* Experience qualifying leads

* Experience handling objections

* Strong follow-up skills

* Confidence conducting outbound outreach rather than relying solely on inbound leads

* Excellent written English, grammar and literacy

* Fluent spoken English

* Ability to understand and naturally communicate with an Australian audience

* Ability to follow sales frameworks while adapting conversations naturally

* Strong organisation and attention to detail

* Confidence tracking leads and KPIs

* Reliability and consistency

* Ability to take feedback and implement it

* Initiative and personal accountability



- HIGHLY PREFERRED: 



*Previous appointment-setting or sales experience within online fitness coaching

* Experience working with fitness coaches

* Experience working across multiple coaching businesses/accounts

* Experience within the Australian fitness industry and selling to an Australian audience

* Experience within women's health, fitness or wellness

* Experience selling personalised coaching services

* CRM experience and Google Sheets experience

* Experience with booking/calendar systems such as Calendly

* Social media lead-generation knowledge

* Experience with Instagram Story lead generation



Relevant tertiary qualifications, professional certifications or recognised training in areas such as:



* Sales

* Marketing

* Digital Marketing

* Business

* Communications

* Social Media Marketing

* Business Development

* Customer Relationship Management

* Appointment Setting



will also be highly regarded.



Proven performance and real-world sales experience, however, are more important than qualifications alone.



- HOURS: 



* Part-time remote position

* Approximately **12 hours per week initially**

* Approximately 3 hours per working day

* Proposed days: **Monday, Wednesday, Thursday and Saturday**

* Must be available during agreed Australian/Sydney time periods

* Saturday availability is important

* Potential for increased hours as the business grows



Active lead conversations should be responded to promptly during scheduled working hours.



- COMPENSATION: 



**Base pay + performance-based commission**



* $5/hour base

* +$10 per qualified consultation that attends

* +$50 per setter-generated consultation that converts into a paying client



Cancelled consultations and no-shows do not receive the $10 commission. If a consultation is rescheduled, commission is paid once the prospect attends.



There is strong opportunity to increase your earnings as your performance and the business grow.



*Base rate subject to applicant location, engagement structure and applicable requirements.



-WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR:



We're looking for someone who is confident, personable, organised, coachable and genuinely motivated by results.



You should be able to follow a sales framework while adapting conversations naturally to the individual. We're looking for someone who takes initiative, identifies opportunities and wants to become part of the Grow & Glow team rather than simply managing another account.



For the right person, there is long-term opportunity for increased hours, earning potential and responsibility as Grow & Glow grows.



- HOW TO APPLY:



Please submit:



* Your CV/resume

* A short summary of your previous DM appointment-setting/sales experience

* Businesses or industries you've previously worked with

* Evidence of previous results/KPIs where available

* Relevant references

* Any relevant qualifications, certifications or completed courses

* A brief explanation of your interest in health and fitness

* Why you believe you'd be a good fit for Grow & Glow Fitness



Shortlisted applicants may be asked to complete a **mock DM sales conversation** as part of the interview process.



**Applications without previous DM appointment-setting/social media sales experience will not be considered.**

⸻



PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

* 
 / Shopify

⸻

Lyons Cards will establish pricing and negotiation guidelines.

* Understand approved negotiation ranges

* Respond to reasonable offers

* Recognize serious buyers

* Avoid unnecessarily discounting inventory

If a card is listed at $500 and an offer falls within an approved range, you may be authorized to continue the negotiation.

Do not guess.



Do not make unauthorized discounts.



⸻



3. CARD INVENTORY INTAKE



A major responsibility will be helping Lyons Cards rapidly load inventory into Card Dealer Pro, our inventory management system.



We are intentionally simplifying this process.



The goal is:



GET THE CARD INTO THE SYSTEM QUICKLY AND ACCURATELY.



You may receive batches of card photographs from Connor or another Lyons Cards team member.



Example:



Connor sends you 20–50 card photographs and basic instructions.



You then create/import the batch and make sure those cards are properly entered into inventory.



⸻



4. TWO PRIMARY INVENTORY BATCHES



Inventory will generally begin in two major categories:



GRADED / SLABS



Examples:



* PSA

* BGS / Beckett

* SGC

* Other approved grading companies



Important information may include:



* Player

* Year

* Set

* Card number

* Parallel

* Serial number

* Grading company

* Grade

* Certification number

* Image

* SKU

* Physical location

* Status



RAW CARDS

Information may include:



* Player

* Year

* Set

* Card number

* Parallel

* Serial number

* Image

* SKU

* Physical location

* Selling price

* Status



We do NOT want unnecessary data entry that slows down the operation.



Accuracy and speed are both important.



⸻



5. INVENTORY STATUS / USE



Cards may be assigned different jobs inside the company.



Examples:



AVAILABLE

Normal inventory available to sell.



HOLD

Do not sell without management approval.



REPACK

Reserved or considered for Lyons Cards repack products.



GRADE

Raw card intended for professional grading.



REVIEW

Management decision required.



You must make sure special inventory is not a

⸻



6. PRICING SUPPORT

You may be given a price directly by Connor or management.



Example:



Connor sends:



Card photos + $349 list price + AVAILABLE

⸻

title: Social Media Manager — Home Service Marketing Agency

About Us



We are a growing U.S.-based marketing agency that primarily works with home service businesses.

We are looking for a high-level Social Media Manager who can take ownership of our clients' social media content and help us continue improving the quality of our content department.



This is not a position where we want someone who simply waits for a list of instructions every day.



We are looking for someone who is extremely organized, has a strong eye for detail, understands good copy, understands what looks professional on social media, and can eventually become a leader within our company.



What You Will Be Doing



You will help manage social media content across multiple client accounts as well as some of our agency's own content.



Your responsibilities will include:



Writing and polishing captions for social media posts

Making sure copy sounds natural for a U.S. audience

Reviewing content before it is sent to clients or published

Quality-checking spelling, grammar, formatting, branding, and overall presentation

Organizing and managing content calendars

Making basic updates inside Canva

Adding text, captions, logos, or simple elements to existing designs

Creating simple AI-generated graphics when needed

Reviewing AI-generated content and improving it instead of blindly using AI output

Making sure content actually matches the client's business, services, and audience

Coordinating with video editors, designers, and other members of our marketing team

Keeping track of revisions and client feedback

Making sure content gets completed and published on schedule

Helping improve our internal social media processes as we grow

What This Role Is NOT



This is not primarily a graphic design position.



You do not need to be an advanced graphic designer.



However, you should be very comfortable inside Canva and have enough visual judgment to recognize when something looks clean, professional, balanced, or incorrect.



You should be able to look at a piece of content and immediately notice things like:



Bad grammar

Awkward American English

Poor spacing

Incorrect branding

Misaligned text

Weak captions

Obvious AI-generated wording

Incorrect information

Content that does not make sense for the business



Attention to detail is extremely important for this position.



Who We Are Looking For



We are looking for someone who:



Has strong written English

Understands American business communication and social media

Has experience managing social media accounts

Understands copywriting and marketing

Is proficient with Canva

Has experience using AI tools like ChatGPT

Knows how to use AI as a tool without relying on it for everything

Has excellent attention to detail

Can manage multiple clients and deadlines

Is extremely organized

Communicates clearly

Can take feedback without becoming defensive

Can solve problems independently

Is proactive instead of waiting to be told what to do

Takes ownership when something is wrong

Wants to grow into a leadership position



Experience working with a marketing agency or managing multiple client accounts is strongly preferred.



Experience with home service businesses is a major plus.



What Success Looks Like



The right person should eventually be able to take a client account and understand:



What does this business do?



Who is their customer?



What services should we be talking about?



Does this caption actually sound like the business?



Does the content look professional?



Is everything spelled correctly?



Are we staying consistent?



Is the content calendar moving forward without someone constantly following up?



We want someone who can think through those questions independently.



Compensation



Compensation will range from $1,500 to $2,500 USD per month depending on your experience, competency, and the level of responsibility you are able to take on.



We are willing to pay toward the higher end of the range for someone who is genuinely exceptional.



We are not trying to find the cheapest person possible.



We are trying to find someone talented who we can build around long term.



As the company grows and your responsibilities increase, there will be opportunities for additional compensation and leadership.



How to Apply



Please send:



A short introduction about yourself

Your previous social media management experience

Examples of social media accounts or content you have managed

Examples of captions or copy you have written

Your experience with Canva

Your experience using AI tools for social media

I'm looking for a reliable, versatile VA to help manage day-to-day personal errands and light business support tasks so I can stay focused on the parts of my day only I can do. This is ongoing, long-term work — not a one-off project — for someone who's proactive, discreet, comfortable wearing multiple hats, and doesn't need heavy hand-holding once they understand a task.

---

**$5–8/hour** depending on experience, with video editing experience weighted toward the higher end.

Skills get you the interview. Personality gets you the role.



We have worked with remote team members before and we know the difference between someone who just completes tasks and someone who genuinely shows up for the team. We are looking for the latter.



You are the right person if you:

Are honest and direct. We value straight communication. If you do not know something, say so. If you disagree, say so professionally. We would rather have that conversation than deal with avoidable mistakes.

Take pride in your work. Every asset you produce, every campaign you run, every report you send represents Presidential Group. You hold yourself to a high standard because you care about the outcome, not just the task.

This role is a long-term engagement for the right person. We pay well, we treat our team with respect, and we expect the same in return.

Bring a positive, can-do attitude and maintain it under pressure

Work well independently, take full ownership of your output, and require minimal supervision

Full-time contractor engagement (Monday to Friday, Perth time)

Direct working relationship with the Managing Director

title: Video Editor
description:
We’re looking for an experienced **Short-Form Video Editor** who knows how to turn raw footage into engaging, high-retention Shorts/Reels ranging from approximately **45 seconds to 2 minutes**.



The ideal editor has a strong understanding of short-form content, viewer retention, pacing, hooks, and storytelling. You’ll be expected to review raw footage independently, identify the most engaging and valuable moments, and turn those moments into polished videos designed to capture attention and keep viewers watching..



###Responsibilities



* Review raw footage and independently identify the strongest moments for short-form content.

* Edit footage into engaging **45-second to 2-minute Shorts/Reels**.

* Remove pauses, dead space, unnecessary dialogue, and other moments that negatively affect pacing or viewer retention.

* Create strong openings/hooks that capture attention quickly.

* Use creative judgment to determine the best pacing, cuts, transitions, zooms, and visual elements for each video.

* Add engaging captions/subtitles, on-screen text, sound effects, music, and other appropriate elements when they enhance the content.

* Deliver polished videos that are ready to publish on short-form social platforms.

* Maintain a consistent editing style across content while still keeping each video fresh and engaging.



### Weekly Expectations



The editor will work independently and is expected to produce **10 approved Shorts/Reels per week**.



Each video may require up to **3 rounds of revisions** based on feedback. Applicants should be comfortable receiving feedback and making revisions efficiently while maintaining consistent turnaround times.



### Project Length



This position will begin as a **one-month paid project**. There is potential for ongoing work for an editor who consistently meets quality, creativity, communication, and turnaround expectations.



**Additional performance-based incentives and opportunities for increased earnings will also be available. **



### Who We’re Looking For



We’re looking for someone who:



* Has proven experience editing engaging short-form content.

* Understands what makes viewers stop scrolling and continue watching.

* Can make strong creative decisions without needing detailed instructions for every edit.

* Has excellent attention to pacing, timing, captions, audio, and visual details.

* Is dependable and able to consistently meet weekly deadlines.

* Communicates well and responds professionally to feedback.

* Can maintain quality while producing content consistently.



**To apply, please include examples of Shorts, Reels, TikToks, or other short-form content you have personally edited.** We are especially interested in seeing examples that demonstrate strong hooks, pacing, storytelling, and viewer retention.

description:

About Us



We’re Ride Proud Clothing, a small Australian equestrian apparel brand creating riding clothes specifically for mature women.

We already have an established range of riding pants, jeans and tights, and we’re now working on improving some existing styles and developing new ones.



We have plenty of ideas—and plenty of hand-drawn notes—but we need someone with the technical knowledge to help turn them into clear, accurate instructions a manufacturer can work from.



The Role



We’re looking for an experienced technical apparel developer or tech pack specialist who can help us with:



Creating and updating factory-ready tech packs

Turning sketches and ideas into clear construction details

Preparing measurement specifications and graded size charts

Reviewing garment samples and identifying fit problems

Recommending practical corrections

Recording sample changes clearly for our manufacturers

Helping improve existing styles and develop new products



Our garments are mainly women’s stretch riding pants, jeans and tights, so experience with women’s bottoms, activewear, stretch fabrics, denim or equestrian clothing would be particularly useful.



Equestrian experience would be wonderful, but it isn’t essential. Understanding fit, movement and comfort in women’s clothing matters more.



What We’re Looking For



We’re not a large fashion company with layers of departments and complicated processes. You’ll be working directly with the founder, who knows her customers and products extremely well but doesn’t pretend to speak fluent garment technician.

We’re looking for someone who is:



Experienced in tech packs, garment construction and fit

Able to explain technical recommendations in plain language

Accurate and organised

Reliable with deadlines and communication

Comfortable working from existing garments, measurements, photographs and hand-drawn ideas

Willing to offer solutions when something may not work as planned

Collaborative and not precious about feedback



We value calm competence, honest advice and people who do what they say they’ll do.



Work Style



This is a flexible, project-based position with the potential for regular ongoing work.

There are no set working hours and no micromanaging. You manage your own time, keep us updated and complete the agreed work accurately and on time.



We’ll communicate and share files through Microsoft Teams.



All designs, tech packs and product-development information must remain confidential and belong to Ride Proud Clothing.



How to Apply



Please include:



A short introduction about yourself

Examples of tech packs you have personally created

Details of your experience with women’s pants, stretch garments, activewear or similar products

The software you use

Your usual hourly or project rate

Your availability

A brief explanation of how you normally review and correct the fit of a garment sample



Please don’t send a long, formal cover letter. We’d rather hear from the real person we may be working with.



Use RPTECH2026 in the subject line so we know you’ve read the advertisement.

title: Mortgage Broking Assistant
description:
About us



We are an Australian mortgage broking business based in Sydney. We write residential, investment, refinance, cash-out and self-employed lending across a full panel of Australian lenders. Our team is small, organised and systems driven. We are looking for a long term team member, not a short term contractor.



About the role



As our Mortgage Broking Assistant, you will work directly alongside the broker and take responsibility for the file from initial assessment through to settlement. The broker handles the client relationship and the recommendation. You handle the structuring, the servicing, the compliance pack, the lodgement and the lender follow up. This is not basic data entry. We need someone who can look at a scenario and spot the policy problem before the lender does.



What you will do



Loan preparation and assessment



Prepare and submit PAYG, self-employed and company borrower applications across owner-occupied, investment, refinance and cash-out scenarios

Assess PAYG income correctly, including base, overtime, bonuses and allowances

Assess self-employed income: salary and wages drawn from the applicant's own business, company profit where lender policy allows, depreciation and other common addbacks, and one-off or non-recurring expenses

Review company financial statements, individual and company tax returns, and Notices of Assessment

Work confidently across companies, trusts and sole traders, including related entities and group structures



Credit and servicing



Complete lender servicing calculations and compare borrowing capacity across lenders using Quickli

Assess liabilities, credit limits, living expenses and commitments

Review Equifax credit reports and flag adverse credit, defaults or enquiries early

Apply lender credit policy and identify policy issues before an application is submitted

Put forward suitable lender and product options for the broker based on the applicant's circumstances



Compliance



Prepare Credit Proposals and Preliminary Assessments

Draft clear Best Interests Duty commentary, lender comparisons and reasons for recommendation

Document objectives, requirements and priorities, borrowing capacity, servicing considerations and credit history commentary

Prepare lender submission notes and keep the fact find, compliance documents and lodged application fully consistent



Pre-submission and application management



Obtain pricing requests, order valuations and run credit checks

Cross-check income, liabilities, assets and expenses, and confirm the file is submission ready with minimal errors or omissions

Lodge through ApplyOnline and lender portals

Follow up outstanding requirements, liaise directly with BDMs and credit assessors, and respond to lender questions and conditions

Manage the file through conditional approval, formal approval, loan documents and settlement

Coordinate additional documents from clients as lender conditions come through

Keep Salestrekker notes, milestones and document categorisation accurate at all times



What we are looking for



Minimum [2 to 3] years experience as a mortgage broking assistant, parabroker or loan processor supporting Australian brokers

Hands on experience with Salestrekker 2.0, ApplyOnline and Quickli

Solid working knowledge of Australian lender credit policy and NCCP and Best Interests Duty obligations

Confident handling complex self-employed and company borrower scenarios

Strong written and verbal English. You will be speaking with lenders and assessors directly

Excellent attention to detail and consistency across documents

Proactive by nature. You chase, you flag risks early, and you do not wait to be told each step

Able to prioritise multiple applications at once and keep every file moving

Able to work independently and to Australian business hours

Reliable internet (minimum [25] Mbps), a backup connection, a working laptop or desktop, headset, and a quiet home workspace

Willing to use time tracking software (Hubstaff) during work hours



Bonus points if you have



Experience with an Australian aggregator platform (AFG, Connective, LMG, Loan Market, Outsource Financial)

Construction, commercial or asset finance experience

A finance, accounting or business qualification



What we offer



Stable long term role with an Australian business that values its offshore team

Ongoing training on lender policy and our systems

Direct access to the broker 



How to apply



Please do not send a generic application. Applications that do not follow these steps will not be reviewed.



Start your reply with the word ADDBACK in the subject line.

Send your CV and tell us about the most complex self-employed or company borrower file you have taken to settlement, including how you treated the income.

Answer briefly: which addbacks do you routinely apply when assessing company financials, and how do you d
 whether to use company profit for servicing?

Tell us which CRM, servicing and lodgement systems you have used, and how many active files you typically managed at once.

Include your internet speed test result and confirm your available working hours in AEST.



We reply to every shortlisted applicant. Thank you for taking the time.

title: HIRING: Graphic Designer VA – Baby Apparel, Mugs, Tumblers & Ornaments
description:
We’re looking for a full-time Graphic Designer Virtual Assistant to join our growing e-commerce team. We run several successful Etsy stores in the U.S. that sell custom baby apparel, mugs, tumblers, and Christmas ornaments. Our designs are fun, modern, cute, and family-friendly. You can check out our stores for examples of the style and quality we’re aiming for at 
/shop/FunDayStudiosCo

 and 
/shop/MiniMeeCollection

.



This is a long-term remote position with consistent design work, weekly team communication, and room to grow. We will provide training, branding guides, templates, and inspiration boards to help you succeed.



Your main responsibility will be creating high-quality PNG designs for products like baby onesies, toddler shirts, mugs, tumblers, and holiday ornaments. We typically expect 10–15 finished designs per day, delivered in batches every 2–3 days. You must be comfortable working with Canva, Photoshop, or Illustrator and have a strong eye for layout, color, and fonts. All files must follow our naming and delivery format.



We are looking for someone who is creative, detail-oriented, reliable, and responsive. You’ll be expected to join weekly check-ins, follow clear instructions, and be open to feedback or revisions. You should also be trend-aware and comfortable using Pinterest or Etsy as inspiration (we’ll help train you on this too).



This is a paid, full-time role with the following monthly rate tiers: $400–500/month for entry-level designers, $500–600/month for those consistently delivering 10–15 designs per day, and $600–700+/month for fast, trend-savvy designers. We offer bonuses and raises based on performance.



Please note: from October to December, we do not allow time off. This is our busiest season of the year. You must be available daily for design work and be able to meet fast turnaround deadlines. Overtime may be required during peak periods — and we will pay for any overtime hours.



We welcome designers who use AI tools such as Midjourney, Firefly, or Canva AI — as long as you clearly disclose your AI use in your work. We value transparency and originality. Misrepresenting AI-generated content as fully original will lead to disqualification.



If you’re shortlisted, we may ask you to complete a 1–2 design trial task. This trial is only required if selected and will be paid if you are hired.



To apply, please send your portfolio (especially if you’ve designed for baby/kids, gifts, or seasonal products), a short introduction about yourself, and your availability. Please include the word “8080” in your message so we know you read the full post. Also, let us know if you use any AI tools and how they fit into your workflow.



We’re excited to meet someone who is passionate about design and ready to grow with us long-term. If your style fits what we do at 
/shop/FunDayStudiosCo

 and 
/shop/MiniMeeCollection

, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Web Developer — Technical & On-Page SEO
description:
Web Developer — Technical & On-Page SEO

Company: Click Squad — boutique digital marketing agency (Melbourne, Sydney, Brisbane) 

Engagement: Full
 (approx. 40 hrs per week, flexible — remote) 

Reports to: Managing Director & SEO Manager 

 

About the role

We're a boutique performance agency running Google Ads, paid social and SEO for Australian SMEs. We need a developer who can do more than ship pages — someone who understands why a site ranks and can build and fix accordingly.



You'll work across two fronts: client websites (audits, fixes, builds, migrations) and Click Squad's own web properties. Technical depth matters more to us than build speed. We'd rather you take an extra day and get the crawl architecture right than push a fast site that quietly leaks equity.



This is a hands-on role.  You diagnose, you recommend, you implement.

 

What you'll do

Technical SEO

● Run full technical audits (Screaming Frog, Sitebulb or similar) and turn findings into a prioritised, costed fix list

● Diagnose and resolve crawl and index issues: robots.txt, XML sitemaps, canonicals, pagination, faceted URLs, redirect chains, orphan pages

● Own Core Web Vitals — LCP, INP, CLS — including image delivery, render-blocking resources, caching, CDN and hosting-level fixes

● Implement structured data (LocalBusiness, Service, Product, FAQ, Article, Review) and keep it valid

● Plan and execute site migrations and redirect mapping without traffic loss

● Handle JavaScript rendering issues, hreflang where relevant, and mobile/desktop parity

● Set up and interpret Google Search Console, GA4 and log-file data

On-page SEO

● Build and optimise title tags, meta descriptions, heading structure and internal linking at scale

● Improve information architecture and URL structure for new and existing sites

● Optimise landing pages and templates for both search and conversion

● Work with our content and paid teams so SEO, CRO and ad landing pages don't fight each other

Development

● Build, maintain and improve WordPress sites (custom themes, child themes, page builders) — plus Shopify or Webflow if you have it

● Write clean, semantic, accessible HTML/CSS/JS

● Handle PHP-level customisation, plugin conflicts, staging environments and deployments

● Site speed, security, backups and general site health

● Track and event implementation: GTM, GA4, conversion tracking, call tracking

 

What we're looking for

Essential

● 3+ years combined web development and SEO experience — ideally agency-side

● Demonstrable technical SEO wins you can walk us through (what was broken, what you did, what changed)

● Strong WordPress skills, including PHP, and comfort in the database and server layer

● Fluent with Screaming Frog, GSC, GA4, PageSpeed Insights / Lighthouse

● Understands how Google actually crawls, renders and indexes — not just a checklist follower

● Clear written English and the ability to explain a technical problem to a non-technical client

Nice to have

● Ahrefs, Semrush or similar

● Shopify or Webflow

● Experience with Australian local SEO and Google Business Profile

● Schema beyond the basics

● Some CRO or landing page testing background

● Git, staging/production workflows

 

How we work

● Small team, direct access to the founder, no layers of approval

● You'll manage your own workload across multiple client sites

● We care about outcomes, not hours logged — but we do care about clear communication and hitting deadlines

● Overlap with Melbourne business hours (AEST/AEDT) is required for a few hours daily

 

Application

Send through:

1. Two or three examples of technical SEO problems you've solved — the problem, your approach, the result

2. Sites you've built or substantially rebuilt

3. Your availability and rate

4. A short note on which SEO tools you'd want us to license and why

Applications without specific examples won't be reviewed.

title: Provider Enrollment and Credentialing Specialist
description:
About GetPaneled



GetPaneled helps healthcare providers, primarily behavioral health professionals and group practices, get credentialed and enrolled with insurance payers across the United States.



We are a growing U.S.-based company building technology to make provider credentialing faster, more reliable, and easier to manage.



We are looking for an experienced credentialing specialist who can independently manage provider enrollment work and help us deliver a high-quality experience for our customers.



This is not a general virtual assistant role. We are specifically looking for someone with hands-on experience in U.S. healthcare credentialing, payer enrollment, or provider enrollment.



What You Will Do



You will manage credentialing and enrollment work for individual providers and group practices, including:



Commercial payer enrollment and credentialing

Medicare enrollment through PECOS

Medicaid enrollment through state-specific portals

CAQH setup, maintenance, and reattestation

NPI and NPPES review and updates

Individual and group provider applications

Adding rendering providers to existing groups

Reviewing W-9, Tax ID, NPI, practice, and provider information for consistency

Uploading required documents and completing payer forms

Following up with insurance companies by portal,
, or phone

Tracking application status and next follow-up dates

Reviewing payer correspondence and determining next steps

Identifying and resolving application issues

Requesting missing information from providers

Updating internal application records accurately

Responding to routine provider and customer questions by

Escalating unusual or high-risk situations when appropriate

What We Are Looking For



You should have at least 2 years of direct U.S. provider credentialing or payer enrollment experience.



Strong candidates will have experience with several of the following:



Aetna

UnitedHealthcare and Optum

Cigna and Evernorth

Blue Cross Blue Shield plans

Humana

Carelon

Molina

Ambetter and Centene

Medicare and PECOS

State Medicaid programs

CAQH ProView

NPPES

Availity



Behavioral health credentialing experience is strongly preferred, including experience with providers such as:



LCSW

LMFT

LPC

LMHC

Psychologists

Psychiatrists

PMHNPs

Nurse Practitioners



Experience with both individual and group practice enrollment is a major plus.



The Most Important Qualities



We care more about judgment and ownership than simply knowing how to fill out forms.



You should be someone who:



Can work independently without needing constant instructions

Notices inconsistencies before submitting an application

Can investigate an unfamiliar payer issue and determine the next step

Knows when something is routine and when it should be escalated

Follows through until an issue is actually resolved

Is highly organized and does not allow applications or follow-ups to fall through the cracks

Communicates clearly in written English

Is comfortable communicating professionally with U.S. healthcare providers and insurance companies

Takes responsibility for mistakes and learns from them

Is comfortable working in a fast-moving startup environment where processes are continuously improving



Schedule

Full-time

40 hours per week

Long-term position

Overlap with U.S. Eastern Time will be required

Exact working hours can be discussed

Compensation



$7 to $12 USD per hour depending on experience and demonstrated ability.



Candidates with stronger credentialing experience, strong independent judgment, or the ability to handle more complex cases may qualify for the higher end of the range.



There may also be opportunities for increased responsibility and compensation over time based on performance.



Growth Opportunity



We are building a growing credentialing operation alongside automation and AI systems.



Strong performers may have opportunities to take on responsibilities such as:



Quality assurance

Training other team members

Reviewing difficult applications

Managing payer workflows

Helping improve credentialing procedures

Supporting and evaluating automation systems



We are looking for people who are interested in growing with the company and taking increasing ownership over time.



How to Apply



Please answer the following questions in your application.



How many years of direct U.S. healthcare credentialing or payer enrollment experience do you have?

Which insurance payers have you personally completed applications for? Please separate commercial insurance, Medicare, and Medicaid.

Which Medicaid states have you personally enrolled providers in?

Describe your Medicare and PECOS experience. Please explain what types of applications you have personally completed.

Have you credentialed both individual providers and group practices? Please explain.

Approximately how many provider or payer applications have you managed at one time?

Tell us about one difficult credentialing problem you personally solved. Please explain:

What went wrong?

How did you identify the problem?

What did you do?

What was the outcome?

Imagine an application has been sitting with a payer for 45 days and the provider asks for an update. What steps would you take before responding to the provider?

If information in CAQH does not match the provider's W-9 or NPI record, what would you do before submitting the payer application?

What hourly rate are you requesting in USD?

Are you available for 40 hours per week?

Please include the phrase "Provider Enrollment" at the top of your application so we know you read the full posting.

You Must Have

 Lender portal experience — submitting and tracking applications with major AU asset finance lenders (e.g. Westpac, NAB, ANZ, Macquarie, Pepper Money, Angle Finance, Grow Finance, Shift, ScotPac, Liberty, Fifo Capital)

Education

Candidates without a degree but with 2+ years of direct broker support experience are strongly encouraged to apply.



What We Offer

HMO coverage

Leave credits

13th Month Pay

Career growth — we're building a 50+ person capability centre within 12 months

This is a direct broker support role — you work for the broker, not a lender or bank. You are the engine behind the broker's business, managing their asset finance pipeline, keeping deals moving, and making sure nothing falls through the cracks between application and settlement.

You'll be part of Pierian Australia's dedicated back-office capability centre, supporting Australian asset finance brokers across commercial equipment, vehicles, technology, and other asset classes.

title: Outbound Calling VA – Excellent Spoken English Required
description:
We are a small U.S.-based service business looking for a part-time VA to make outbound phone calls to construction and heavy-equipment companies.



This is NOT a high-pressure sales role.



Your main job is to call companies we have already researched, speak with receptionists or office staff, identify the person responsible for their equipment or fleet maintenance, and gather the best contact information for that person. 



Sometimes you will speak directly with the decision-maker. When that happens, your goal is simply to start a friendly conversation, learn how they currently handle maintenance, and determine whether it makes sense for our owner to follow up.



What You’ll Do:



* Make outbound calls to U.S. businesses (during US Mountain Time business hours)

* Speak with receptionists, office staff, owners, fleet managers, and equipment managers

* Find the correct decision-maker

* Gather direct phone numbers,
 addresses, extensions, and other contact information

* Ask a few simple qualifying questions

* Schedule or recommend follow-up calls for the owner

* Update all call notes and contact information in HubSpot CRM

* Follow up with companies multiple times when necessary

* Keep clean, accurate records of every call



What This Job Is NOT:



You will not be expected to close sales.



You will not negotiate pricing.



You will not need deep knowledge of heavy equipment.



You will not be reading long sales scripts or aggressively pressuring people.



We want you to sound: natural, friendly, confident, and helpful.



The Most Important Requirement:



**Excellent spoken English is required.**



We are looking for someone who sounds comfortable and conversational speaking with U.S. customers over the phone.



You should be:



* Easy to understand

* Confident speaking with strangers

* Friendly and personable

* Comfortable hearing “no”

* Persistent without being pushy

* Organized

* Reliable

* Coachable

* Comfortable using a CRM such as HubSpot



Previous experience in cold calling, appointment setting, customer service, call centers, real estate prospecting, or similar phone work is helpful, but not required if you are an excellent communicator.

Schedule:



Approximately 15–20 hours per week to start.



Most calling will take place during normal U.S. business hours in the US Mountain Time Zone.



There may be an opportunity for more hours and responsibility as the business grows.



Pay:



Starting pay: $5–$6 USD per hour, depending on experience and communication ability.



There may also be performance bonuses for producing qualified opportunities, and room to grow into one of our closers if you so choose. 



About Us:



We provide mobile preventative maintenance services for construction companies and heavy-equipment fleets in Utah.



Our customers operate equipment such as excavators, loaders, dozers, skid steers, cranes, trucks, and other heavy machinery.



We are a growing company, and this person will play an important role in helping us build a consistent sales pipeline.



We are looking for someone who would like to **grow with us long-term**, not someone looking for a temporary side project.



How to Apply:



Please send:



1. A short introduction about yourself and your phone/calling experience.

2. Your hourly rate.

3. Your availability during U.S. Mountain Time business hours.

4. A 60–90 second voice recording answering this question:



**“Tell me about a time you had to speak with someone you didn’t know and quickly make them feel comfortable talking to you.”**



Please do not read a prepared script for the recording. We want to hear how you naturally communicate.



At the bottom of your application, include the words **HEAVY EQUIPMENT** so we know you read the entire posting.



We will invite a small group of applicants to a short video interview and phone-call role play.

title: Software Developer
description:
We are looking for a software developer who has embraced the major shift happening in software development over the last 1–2 years.



We are not specifically looking for the developer with the most years of traditional programming experience. We are looking for someone who has learned how to use modern AI development tools to build good software faster and more effectively.  We have incorpoirated these systems fully into our process, and we with that we need team members that also know what Codex, Claude or Cursor are and how to use them



If your development workflow still looks basically the same as it did three years ago, this probably isn't the right role.



What We're Looking For



We're looking for someone who:



* Uses AI coding tools as a core part of their everyday development workflow

* Has hands-on experience with tools such as **OpenAI Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot**, or similar

* Knows how to give AI enough context to work effectively within a larger codebase

* Can use AI to investigate existing systems, build features, refactor code, debug issues and write tests

* Understands when to trust AI-generated code—and when not to

* Can move quickly from an idea or specification to working software

* Is comfortable working across different technologies rather than being locked into one framework

* Understands Git, APIs, databases, frontend/backend development and normal software engineering fundamentals

* Is interested in experimenting with agents, MCP, automation and emerging AI development workflows



What We Don't Care About



You don't need 10+ years of experience.



You don't need to have spent your entire career specializing in one framework.



Someone with 2–5 years of development experience who has become extremely effective with AI-assisted development may be much more interesting to us than someone with 15 years of experience who hasn't adapted their workflow.



The Work



You'll work on real client software projects and internal products, including:



* Web applications

* Business operations software

* APIs and integrations

* Internal tools

* AI-enabled applications and workflows

* Existing systems that need to be understood, improved or rebuilt



Our projects vary, so being able to quickly understand an unfamiliar codebase or technology is important.



The Person We're Looking For



You are probably a good fit if you've found yourself thinking:



**“AI has completely changed the way I develop software.”**



You experiment with new tools as they appear. You've figured out workflows that allow you to accomplish significantly more than you could through traditional development alone.



## When Applying



Please don't send us a generic cover letter.



Instead, tell us:



What AI development tools do you currently use?  Walk us through your normal AI-assisted development workflow, send a recorded Loom or video please

title: Mortgage Processing Assistant / Loan Admin (AU Mortgage Broker)
description:
About us



We are an Australian mortgage broking business based in Sydney. We write residential, investment, refinance, cash-out and self-employed lending across a full panel of Australian lenders. Our team is small, organised and systems driven. We are looking for a long term team member, not a short term contractor.



About the role



This is a genuine parabroker role, not basic data entry. You will own the file from initial assessment through to settlement: structuring the scenario, running servicing, preparing the compliance pack, lodging through ApplyOnline, and dealing directly with BDMs and credit assessors until the loan settles. We need someone who can look at a deal and spot the policy problem before the lender does.



What you will do



Loan preparation and assessment



Prepare and submit PAYG, self-employed and company borrower applications across owner-occupied, investment, refinance and cash-out scenarios

Assess PAYG income correctly, including base, overtime, bonuses and allowances

Assess self-employed income: salary and wages drawn from the applicant's own business, company profit where lender policy allows, depreciation and other common addbacks, and one-off or non-recurring expenses

Review company financial statements, individual and company tax returns, and Notices of Assessment

Work confidently across companies, trusts and sole traders, including related entities and group structures



Credit and servicing



Complete lender servicing calculations and compare borrowing capacity across lenders using Quickli

Assess liabilities, credit limits, living expenses and commitments

Review Equifax credit reports and flag adverse credit, defaults or enquiries early

Apply lender credit policy and identify policy issues before an application is submitted

Recommend suitable lender and product options based on the applicant's circumstances



Compliance



Prepare Credit Proposals and Preliminary Assessments

Write clear Best Interests Duty commentary, lender comparisons and reasons for recommendation

Document objectives, requirements and priorities, borrowing capacity, servicing considerations and credit history commentary

Prepare lender submission notes and keep the fact find, compliance documents and lodged application fully consistent



Pre-submission and application management



Obtain pricing requests, order valuations and run credit checks

Cross-check income, liabilities, assets and expenses, and confirm the file is submission ready with minimal errors or omissions

Lodge through ApplyOnline and lender portals

Follow up outstanding requirements, liaise directly with BDMs and credit assessors, and respond to lender questions and conditions

Manage the file through conditional approval, formal approval, loan documents and settlement

Keep Salestrekker notes, milestones and document categorisation accurate at all times



What we are looking for



Minimum [2 to 3] years experience as a parabroker or loan processor supporting Australian mortgage brokers

Hands on experience with Salestrekker 2.0, ApplyOnline and Quickli

Solid working knowledge of Australian lender credit policy and NCCP and Best Interests Duty obligations

Confident handling complex self-employed and company borrower scenarios

Strong written and verbal English. You will be speaking with lenders and assessors directly

Excellent attention to detail and consistency across documents

Proactive by nature. You chase, you flag risks early, and you do not wait to be told each step

Able to prioritise multiple applications at once and keep every file moving

Able to work Australian business hours

Reliable internet (minimum [25] Mbps), a backup connection, a working laptop or desktop, headset, and a quiet home workspace

Willing to use time tracking software (Hubstaff) during work hours



Bonus points if you have



Experience with an Australian aggregator platform (AFG, Connective, LMG, Loan Market, Outsource Financial)

Construction, commercial or asset finance experience

A finance, accounting or business qualification



What we offer



Stable long term role with an Australian business that values its offshore team

Ongoing training on lender policy and our systems

Direct access to the broker



How to apply



Please do not send a generic application. Applications that do not follow these steps will not be reviewed.



Start your reply with the word ADDBACK in the subject line.

Send your CV and tell us about the most complex self-employed or company borrower file you have taken to settlement, including how you treated the income.

Answer briefly: which addbacks do you routinely apply when assessing company financials, and how do you d
 whether to use company profit for servicing?

Tell us which CRM, servicing and lodgement systems you have used, and how many active files you typically managed at once.

Record a 1 to 2 minute video or voice recording introducing yourself in English and share the link.

Include your internet speed test result and confirm your available working hours in AEST.



We reply to every shortlisted applicant. Thank you for taking the time.
